hexagrams.name: 乾
hexagrams.gistZh: 純陽剛健，自強不息的創生之力。
hexagrams.gistEn: Pure yang — the strong, unceasing creative force.
hexagrams.tuan: 大哉乾元，萬物資始，乃統天。雲行雨施，品物流形，大明終始，六位時成。時乘六龍以御天，乾道變化，各正性命，保合大和，乃利貞。首出庶物，萬國咸寧。
hexagrams.daxiang: 天行健，君子以自強不息。

yao.text: 君子終日乾乾，夕惕若；厲，无咎。

xugua.zh: 有天地，然後萬物生焉。
xugua.en: There are heaven and earth, and only then do the myriad things come into being.

hexagrams.logicZh: 序卦傳沒有直接寫出乾、坤的名字，只以「有天地」一語帶過：乾為天，坤為地，二者是一切生成的前提， 所以不需要任何「理由」來引出——它們本身就是起點。乾居首位，代表純粹的創生力量：剛健、主動、不息。 整個卦序的故事，從這股力量開始。
hexagrams.logicEn: The Xugua never names Qian 乾 and Kun 坤; it only says "there are heaven and earth." Qian is heaven and Kun is earth, the precondition of everything that follows, so they need no justification: they are the starting point itself. Qian stands first as pure creative energy — strong, active, unceasing. The whole story of the sequence begins from this force.

hexagrams.name: 坤
hexagrams.gistZh: 純陰柔順，厚德載物的承受之力。
hexagrams.gistEn: Pure yin — the yielding power that receives and sustains all things.
hexagrams.judgment: 元亨。利牝馬之貞。君子有攸往，先迷後得主。利西南得朋，東北喪朋。安貞，吉。
hexagrams.tuan: 至哉坤元，萬物資生，乃順承天。坤厚載物，德合无疆；含弘光大，品物咸亨。牝馬地類，行地无疆，柔順利貞。君子攸行，先迷失道，後順得常。西南得朋，乃與類行，東北喪朋，乃終有慶。安貞之吉，應地无疆。
hexagrams.daxiang: 地勢坤，君子以厚德載物。

yao.xiang: 履霜堅冰，陰始凝也。馴致其道，至堅冰也。
六二之動，直以方也。不習无不利，地道光也。

yao.text: 含章，可貞。或從王事，无成有終。
yao.xiang: 含章可貞，以時發也。或從王事，知光大也。

xugua.zh: 有天地，然後萬物生焉。
xugua.en: There are heaven and earth, and only then do the myriad things come into being.

hexagrams.logicZh: 坤與乾是一對「錯卦」（六爻全反）：乾六爻皆陽，坤六爻皆陰。有創生必有承載，有天必有地——乾發動，坤成就。 序卦傳把兩者合為一句「有天地」，正說明它們不可分離，是一體兩面。從第三卦開始，天地交合而萬物生， 故事才真正展開。
hexagrams.logicEn: Kun 坤 is the mirror image of Qian 乾, with every line inverted: all yin against all yang. Creation needs something to receive and complete it — heaven initiates, earth brings to fruition. By folding both into the single phrase "heaven and earth," the Xugua treats them as two sides of one reality. From hexagram 3 on, heaven and earth interact, things are born, and the story proper begins.

hexagrams.name: 屯
hexagrams.gistZh: 萬物初生，艱難之中蘊藏生機。
hexagrams.gistEn: Life pushes through the soil — beginnings are hard but full of promise.
hexagrams.judgment: 元亨，利貞。勿用有攸往，利建侯。
hexagrams.tuan: 屯，剛柔始交而難生，動乎險中，大亨貞。雷雨之動滿盈，天造草昧，宜建侯而不寧。
hexagrams.daxiang: 雲雷，屯；君子以經綸。

yao.xiang: 雖磐桓，志行正也。以貴下賤，大得民也。

yao.text: 屯如邅如，乘馬班如，匪寇婚媾，女子貞不字，十年乃字。
yao.xiang: 六二之難，乘剛也。十年乃字，反常也。

yao.text: 即鹿无虞，惟入于林中，君子幾不如舍，往吝。
yao.xiang: 即鹿无虞，以從禽也。君子舍之，往吝窮也。

yao.text: 乘馬班如，求婚媾，往，吉无不利。

xugua.zh: 盈天地之間者，唯萬物，故受之以屯；屯者盈也，屯者物之始生也。
xugua.en: What fills the space between heaven and earth is nothing but the myriad things; therefore Zhun follows. Zhun means filling; Zhun is things just beginning to be born.

hexagrams.logicZh: 天地既立，其間便被萬物充滿。「屯」字像草芽破土而出、捲曲未伸，正是新生命掙扎著誕生的樣子。 所以屯有兩層意思：充盈（萬物湧現）與初生之難（剛剛冒頭，處境艱難）。卦象上坎（險）下震（動）， 動於險中——任何開始都伴隨著混亂與困難。
hexagrams.logicEn: With heaven and earth in place, the space between them fills with living things. The character 屯 pictures a sprout pushing through the soil, still curled. So Zhun means both fullness — life welling up — and the hardship of birth. Its image, Water (danger) above Thunder (movement), is movement inside danger: every beginning comes with chaos and struggle.

hexagrams.name: 蒙
hexagrams.gistZh: 蒙昧初開，需要啟蒙與教育。
hexagrams.gistEn: The unformed young mind, in need of teaching.
hexagrams.judgment: 亨。匪我求童蒙，童蒙求我。初筮告，再三瀆，瀆則不告。利貞。
hexagrams.tuan: 蒙，山下有險，險而止，蒙。蒙亨，以亨行，時中也。匪我求童蒙，童蒙求我，志應也。初筮告，以剛中也。再三瀆，瀆則不告，瀆蒙也。蒙以養正，聖功也。
hexagrams.daxiang: 山下出泉，蒙；君子以果行育德。

yao.text: 發蒙，利用刑人，用說桎梏，以往吝。
勿用取女，見金夫，不有躬，无攸利。

xugua.zh: 物生必蒙，故受之以蒙；蒙者蒙也，物之穉也。
xugua.en: Things that are born are necessarily immature; therefore Meng follows. Meng means covered over; it is things in their infancy.

hexagrams.logicZh: 生命誕生之後，首先是懵懂無知的幼年。「蒙」本指被覆蓋、看不清，引申為蒙昧、稚嫩。剛出生的東西必然未開化， 需要啟蒙和教育——所以蒙卦的卦辭講師生關係：「匪我求童蒙，童蒙求我。」屯與蒙互為綜卦（上下顛倒）， 一個講出生，一個講幼年。
hexagrams.logicEn: After birth comes the unknowing stage of childhood. Meng originally means covered or veiled, hence dim and immature. Anything newly born is undeveloped and must be taught, which is why Meng's judgment is about teacher and pupil: "It is not I who seek the young fool; the young fool seeks me." Zhun 屯 and Meng 蒙 are an inverted pair — birth, then infancy.

hexagrams.name: 需
hexagrams.gistZh: 雲在天上而雨未降——耐心等待，涵養待時。
hexagrams.gistEn: Clouds gather but rain has not yet fallen — patient waiting and nourishment.
hexagrams.judgment: 有孚，光亨。貞吉，利涉大川。
hexagrams.tuan: 需，須也，險在前也；剛健而不陷，其義不困窮矣。需，有孚，光亨，貞吉，位乎天位，以正中也。利涉大川，往有功也。
hexagrams.daxiang: 雲上於天，需；君子以飲食宴樂。

yao.xiang: 需于郊，不犯難行也。利用恆，无咎，未失常也。
需于沙，衍在中也。雖小有言，以吉終也。
需于泥，災在外也。自我致寇，敬慎不敗也。

yao.text: 入于穴，有不速之客三人來，敬之終吉。
yao.xiang: 不速之客來，敬之終吉。雖不當位，未大失也。

xugua.zh: 物穉不可不養也，故受之以需；需者飲食之道也。
xugua.en: Things in their infancy must be nourished; therefore Xu follows. Xu is the way of food and drink.

hexagrams.logicZh: 幼小的生命首先需要養育。序卦傳把「需」解作「飲食之道」——人最基本的需要就是吃喝。卦象乾（剛健）在下、 坎（雲雨）在上：雲已在天，雨尚未降，所以需又有「等待」之意。滋養需要時間，不能揠苗助長， 要耐心等待時機成熟。
hexagrams.logicEn: Young life must first be fed. The Xugua glosses Xu as "the way of food and drink," the most basic need of all. Its image puts Heaven (strength) below Water (clouds): the clouds have gathered but the rain has not yet fallen, so Xu also means waiting. Nourishment takes time; you cannot tug the shoots to make them grow, but must wait for the right moment.

hexagrams.name: 訟
hexagrams.gistZh: 利益相爭而起訴訟，宜適可而止。
hexagrams.gistEn: Disputes over interests — know when to stop.
hexagrams.judgment: 有孚，窒，惕，中吉，終凶。利見大人，不利涉大川。
hexagrams.tuan: 訟，上剛下險，險而健，訟。訟，有孚，窒，惕，中吉，剛來而得中也。終凶，訟不可成也。利見大人，尚中正也。不利涉大川，入于淵也。
hexagrams.daxiang: 天與水違行，訟；君子以作事謀始。

yao.xiang: 不永所事，訟不可長也。雖小有言，其辯明也。

yao.text: 不克訟，歸而逋，其邑人三百戶无眚。
yao.xiang: 不克訟，歸逋竄也。自下訟上，患至掇也。

yao.text: 食舊德，貞厲，終吉。或從王事，无成。
不克訟，復即命渝，安貞吉。
或錫之鞶帶，終朝三褫之。

xugua.zh: 飲食必有訟，故受之以訟。
xugua.en: Where there is food and drink there will be disputes; therefore Song follows.

hexagrams.logicZh: 有了資源就有分配，有分配就有爭執。為了飲食（引申為一切利益），人們必然發生爭訟。需與訟互為綜卦： 需是坎在乾上，耐心等待；訟是乾在坎上——天往上走，水往下流，背道而馳，象徵立場相違、各不相讓。 卦辭說「中吉，終凶」：爭訟要適可而止。
hexagrams.logicEn: Where there are resources there is distribution, and where there is distribution there is dispute. Over food — and by extension every interest — people inevitably quarrel. Xu 需 and Song 訟 are an inverted pair. In Song, Heaven rises while Water flows down; they move apart, like two parties who will not yield. The judgment advises: "stopping halfway brings good fortune; pressing to the end brings misfortune."

hexagrams.name: 師
hexagrams.gistZh: 爭端擴大為群體衝突；用兵須正，將帥須賢。
hexagrams.gistEn: Conflict grows into war — it needs a just cause and a capable leader.
hexagrams.tuan: 師，眾也。貞，正也。能以眾正，可以王矣。剛中而應，行險而順，以此毒天下，而民從之，吉又何咎矣。
hexagrams.daxiang: 地中有水，師；君子以容民畜衆。

yao.text: 在師中吉，无咎；王三錫命。
yao.xiang: 在師中吉，承天寵也。王三錫命，懷萬邦也。

yao.text: 田有禽，利執言，无咎。長子帥師，弟子輿尸，貞凶。
yao.xiang: 長子帥師，以中行也。弟子輿尸，使不當也。

yao.text: 大君有命，開國承家，小人勿用。
yao.xiang: 大君有命，以正功也。小人勿用，必亂邦也。

xugua.zh: 訟必有眾起，故受之以師；師者眾也。
xugua.en: Disputes are sure to stir up the masses; therefore Shi follows. Shi means the multitude.

hexagrams.logicZh: 個人之間的爭訟一旦擴大，就會牽動群體，演變成集體衝突——戰爭。「師」本義是眾人、軍隊。卦象坤（地、眾）在上， 坎（水）在下：地中有水，如同兵藏於民。全卦唯一的陽爻九二居下卦之中，代表統率眾人的將帥。 用兵的關鍵在於「貞」：正當的目的與得力的領導。
hexagrams.logicEn: When private disputes escalate, they draw in whole groups and become collective conflict — war. Shi originally means the multitude, an army. Earth (the masses) lies over Water: water hidden in the earth, like soldiers hidden among the people. The single yang line, in the second place, is the general who leads the many. Military action is good only with a right cause and a capable leader.

hexagrams.name: 比
hexagrams.gistZh: 眾人親附於一個中心，團結凝聚。
hexagrams.gistEn: People rally and bond around a center.
hexagrams.judgment: 吉。原筮元永貞，无咎。不寧方來，後夫凶。
hexagrams.tuan: 比，吉也。比，輔也，下順從也。原筮，元永貞，无咎，以剛中也。不寧方來，上下應也。後夫凶，其道窮也。
hexagrams.daxiang: 地上有水，比；先王以建萬國，親諸侯。

yao.text: 有孚，比之，无咎。有孚盈缶，終來有它，吉。
顯比。王用三驅，失前禽，邑人不誡，吉。
yao.xiang: 顯比之吉，位正中也。舍逆取順，失前禽也。邑人不誡，上使中也。

xugua.zh: 眾必有所比，故受之以比；比者比也。
xugua.en: The multitude must have something to join with; therefore Bi follows. Bi means closeness.

hexagrams.logicZh: 眾人聚在一起，不能一盤散沙，必須互相親附、團結在一個中心周圍。「比」是親近、依附。師與比互為綜卦： 師的唯一陽爻在下卦（將帥在下統兵），比的唯一陽爻在九五（君主在上，萬民歸附）。戰爭之後要建立聯盟與秩序， 從軍事組織轉向政治凝聚。
hexagrams.logicEn: A gathered multitude cannot stay a loose crowd; people must bond and unite around a center. Bi means closeness, attachment. Shi 師 and Bi 比 are an inverted pair: in Shi the single yang line is low (a general commanding troops); in Bi it sits in the fifth place (a ruler to whom the people rally). After war comes alliance: from military organization to political cohesion.

hexagrams.name: 小畜
hexagrams.gistZh: 初步的積蓄，力量尚小——密雲不雨。
hexagrams.gistEn: A first, modest accumulation — dense clouds, no rain yet.
hexagrams.tuan: 小畜，柔得位而上下應之，曰小畜。健而巽，剛中而志行，乃亨。密雲不雨，尚往也。自我西郊，施未行也。
hexagrams.daxiang: 風行天上，小畜，君子以懿文德。

yao.text: 既雨既處，尚德載，婦貞厲，月幾望，君子征凶。
yao.xiang: 既雨既處，德積載也。君子征凶，有所疑也。

xugua.zh: 比必有所畜也，故受之以小畜。
xugua.en: Closeness is sure to lead to accumulation; therefore Xiao Xu follows.

hexagrams.logicZh: 人們團結親附之後，就能積聚力量與財富。「畜」有蓄積和畜止兩層意思。但這種積蓄還是「小」的： 全卦只有一個陰爻（六四）去畜止五個陽爻，力量有限，如同卦辭所說「密雲不雨」——雲已密布，雨還下不來。 這是初步的積累，還不足以成大事。
hexagrams.logicEn: Once people bond together they can accumulate strength and wealth. 畜 means both storing up and restraining. But this accumulation is still small: a single yin line (fourth place) tries to hold back five yang lines. Its power is limited, as in the judgment's "dense clouds but no rain." It is a first accumulation, not yet enough for great things.

hexagrams.name: 履
hexagrams.gistZh: 循禮而行，如履虎尾而不被咬。
hexagrams.gistEn: Proper conduct — treading on the tiger's tail without being bitten.
hexagrams.tuan: 履，柔履剛也。說而應乎乾，是以履虎尾，不咥人，亨，利貞。剛中正，履帝位而不疚，光明也。
hexagrams.daxiang: 上天下澤，履；君子以辨上下，定民志。

yao.text: 眇能視，跛能履，履虎尾，咥人，凶。武人為于大君。
yao.xiang: 眇能視，不足以有明也。跛能履，不足以與行也。咥人之凶，位不當也。武人為于大君，志剛也。

xugua.zh: 物畜然後有禮，故受之以履。
xugua.en: When things have been accumulated, there is ritual propriety; therefore Lü follows.

hexagrams.logicZh: 「倉廩實而知禮節」——物質有了積累，才談得上禮儀規範。「履」本是踩、行走，引申為行為、實踐； 序卦傳把它和「禮」聯繫起來：禮就是人應當踐行的道路。卦辭「履虎尾，不咥人」，說明只要循禮而行、謹慎小心， 即使處境危險也能安然無恙。小畜與履互為綜卦。
hexagrams.logicEn: "When the granaries are full, people know propriety": only after material accumulation can rules of conduct take hold. Lü 履 means to tread, hence conduct, and the Xugua links it to li 禮, ritual — the path one ought to walk. "Treading on the tiger's tail, it does not bite": careful, proper conduct keeps you safe even in danger. Xiao Xu 小畜 and Lü 履 are an inverted pair.

hexagrams.name: 泰
hexagrams.gistZh: 天地相交，上下通達，太平安泰。
hexagrams.gistEn: Heaven and earth meet; everything flows — a time of peace.
hexagrams.tuan: 泰，小往大來，吉亨。則是天地交而萬物通也，上下交而其志同也。內陽而外陰，內健而外順，內君子而外小人，君子道長，小人道消也。
hexagrams.daxiang: 天地交，泰；后以財成天地之道，輔相天地之宜，以左右民。

yao.text: 包荒。用馮河，不遐遺；朋亡。得尚于中行。
yao.xiang: 包荒，得尚于中行，以光大也。

yao.text: 无平不陂，无往不復，艱貞无咎。勿恤其孚，于食有福。
翩翩，不富以其鄰；不戒以孚。
yao.xiang: 翩翩不富，皆失實也。不戒以孚，中心願也。

yao.text: 城復于隍，勿用師，自邑告命，貞吝。

xugua.zh: 履而泰，然後安，故受之以泰；泰者通也。
xugua.en: Treading properly brings ease, and then there is security; therefore Tai follows. Tai means flowing through.

hexagrams.logicZh: 人人循禮而行，社會便通達安定。泰卦是坤（地）在上、乾（天）在下：看似顛倒，其實天氣下降、地氣上升， 兩者相交，所以萬物亨通。這是上經的第一個高峰——上下溝通、陰陽調和的太平景象。
hexagrams.logicEn: When everyone conducts themselves properly, society flows and is at ease. Tai 泰 places Earth above Heaven. This looks upside down, but heaven's energy descends and earth's rises, so they meet and everything flows. It is the first high point of the Upper Canon: communication between high and low, yin and yang in harmony.

hexagrams.name: 否
hexagrams.gistZh: 天地不交，上下隔絕，閉塞不通。
hexagrams.gistEn: Heaven and earth drift apart — nothing gets through.
hexagrams.judgment: 否之匪人，不利君子貞，大往小來。
hexagrams.tuan: 否之匪人，不利君子貞，大往小來。則是天地不交而萬物不通也，上下不交而天下无邦也。內陰而外陽，內柔而外剛，內小人而外君子，小人道長，君子道消也。
hexagrams.daxiang: 天地不交，否；君子以儉德辟難，不可榮以祿。

yao.text: 休否，大人吉。其亡其亡，繫于苞桑。

xugua.zh: 物不可以終通，故受之以否。
xugua.en: Things cannot flow freely forever; therefore Pi follows.

hexagrams.logicZh: 這是序卦傳第一次出現「物不可以終……」的句式：任何狀態都不能永遠持續，盛極必衰。泰與否互為綜卦， 也互為錯卦。天在上、地在下，看似「正位」，實則天氣上升、地氣下沉，各走各的，上下不交而閉塞不通。 太平之後便是閉塞，這是《易》「物極必反」的典型。
hexagrams.logicEn: Here the Xugua first uses its signature formula, "things cannot … forever": no state lasts, and every peak turns. Tai 泰 and Pi 否 are both inverted and opposite versions of each other. Heaven above, Earth below looks "correct," but heaven's energy rises and earth's sinks; they drift apart and nothing gets through. After peace comes blockage — the classic case of reversal at the extreme.

hexagrams.name: 同人
hexagrams.gistZh: 與人和同，胸懷廣大，打破隔閡。
hexagrams.gistEn: Joining with others, openly and widely, to break through isolation.
hexagrams.judgment: 同人于野，亨。利涉大川，利君子貞。
hexagrams.tuan: 同人，柔得位得中，而應乎乾，曰同人。同人曰，同人于野，亨。利涉大川，乾行也。文明以健，中正而應，君子正也。唯君子為能通天下之志。
hexagrams.daxiang: 天與火，同人；君子以類族辨物。

yao.text: 伏戎于莽，升其高陵，三歲不興。
yao.xiang: 伏戎于莽，敵剛也。三歲不興，安行也。
乘其墉，義弗克也，其吉，則困而反則也。

yao.text: 同人，先號啕而後笑。大師克相遇。
yao.xiang: 同人之先，以中直也。大師相遇，言相克也。

xugua.zh: 物不可以終否，故受之以同人。
xugua.en: Things cannot remain blocked forever; therefore Tong Ren follows.

hexagrams.logicZh: 閉塞也不會永遠持續。要打破隔閡，就要與人和同、團結志同道合者。同人卦乾（天）在上、離（火）在下： 火焰向上，與天同性，象徵人與人同心。卦辭「同人于野」——在曠野中與人和同，強調胸懷廣大、不分親疏， 這樣才能走出否塞。
hexagrams.logicEn: Blockage does not last forever either. To break out of isolation, people must join with others of like mind. Tong Ren 同人 is Heaven above Fire: flames rise toward heaven and share its nature — people of one heart. "Fellowship in the open country" stresses breadth: uniting without favoritism is how stagnation is overcome.

hexagrams.name: 大有
hexagrams.gistZh: 如日中天，眾人歸附，擁有廣大。
hexagrams.gistEn: Like the sun high in the sky — people gather and abundance follows.
hexagrams.tuan: 大有，柔得尊位，大中而上下應之，曰大有。其德剛健而文明，應乎天而時行，是以元亨。
hexagrams.daxiang: 火在天上，大有；君子以遏惡揚善，順天休命。

yao.text: 公用亨于天子，小人弗克。
yao.xiang: 公用亨于天子，小人害也。
厥孚交如，信以發志也。威如之吉，易而无備也。

xugua.zh: 與人同者，物必歸焉，故受之以大有。
xugua.en: Those who are one with others — things will surely come to them; therefore Da You follows.

hexagrams.logicZh: 能夠與人和同的人，眾人和萬物自然歸附於他，於是擁有廣大。大有卦離（火、日）在天上，如太陽高照，萬物畢見； 唯一的陰爻居於尊位六五，以柔順虛心統領五陽。同人與大有互為綜卦：先有人心的凝聚，然後才有財富與力量的豐盛。
hexagrams.logicEn: Whoever can unite with others draws people and things to them, and so comes to possess much. Da You 大有 is Fire (the sun) high in heaven, lighting everything. Its one yin line sits in the ruler's place, leading five yang lines through openness and receptivity. Tong Ren 同人 and Da You 大有 are an inverted pair: first hearts are united, then abundance follows.

hexagrams.name: 謙
hexagrams.gistZh: 高山藏於地下——有而不居，高而能下。
hexagrams.gistEn: A mountain hidden beneath the earth — great, yet humble.
hexagrams.tuan: 謙，亨，天道下濟而光明，地道卑而上行。天道虧盈而益謙，地道變盈而流謙，鬼神害盈而福謙，人道惡盈而好謙。謙尊而光，卑而不可逾，君子之終也。
hexagrams.daxiang: 地中有山，謙；君子以裒多益寡，稱物平施。

yao.text: 不富，以其鄰，利用侵伐，无不利。

yao.xiang: 鳴謙，志未得也。可用行師，征邑國也。

xugua.zh: 有大者不可以盈，故受之以謙。
xugua.en: One who possesses greatness must not be full to overflowing; therefore Qian follows.

hexagrams.logicZh: 擁有很多時，最大的危險是自滿。滿則溢，所以必須謙虛。謙卦是艮（山）在坤（地）之下：高山藏於地下， 有而不居，高而能下。謙是六十四卦中唯一六爻皆吉或无不利的卦，可見古人對謙德的重視。
hexagrams.logicEn: The great danger of having much is complacency: what is full overflows, so one must be modest. Qian 謙 places Mountain beneath Earth — a high mountain hidden below ground, possessing without displaying. It is the only hexagram in which all six lines are favorable, a sign of how highly the tradition prized modesty.

hexagrams.name: 豫
hexagrams.gistZh: 春雷出地，萬物和樂；樂而不可縱。
hexagrams.gistEn: Spring thunder bursts from the earth — joy, but not indulgence.
hexagrams.tuan: 豫，剛應而志行，順以動，豫。豫，順以動，故天地如之，而況建侯行師乎？天地以順動，故日月不過，而四時不忒；聖人以順動，則刑罰清而民服。豫之時義大矣哉！
hexagrams.daxiang: 雷出地奮，豫。先王以作樂崇德，殷薦之上帝，以配祖考。

yao.text: 由豫，大有得。勿疑。朋盍簪。

yao.xiang: 六五貞疾，乘剛也。恆不死，中未亡也。

xugua.zh: 有大而能謙，必豫，故受之以豫。
xugua.en: Possessing greatness and able to remain modest, one is sure to be at ease; therefore Yu follows.

hexagrams.logicZh: 富有而又謙虛，人心和樂，自然安逸愉悅。「豫」有安樂、喜悅，也有預備之意。豫卦震（雷）出地上，春雷發動， 萬物歡欣。謙與豫互為綜卦：謙是內在的修養，豫是它帶來的和樂。但安樂之中也藏著放縱的危險—— 初六「鳴豫，凶」便是警告。
hexagrams.logicEn: Great and yet modest, one has people's goodwill and naturally feels ease and joy. Yu 豫 means contentment and delight, and also preparedness. Thunder bursts out of the Earth: spring thunder that makes everything rejoice. Qian 謙 and Yu 豫 are an inverted pair: modesty is the inner cultivation, delight the harmony it brings. Yet ease hides the danger of indulgence, as the first line warns: "proclaiming one's delight — misfortune."

hexagrams.name: 隨
hexagrams.gistZh: 我動而彼悅，相隨而行；隨從須擇善。
hexagrams.gistEn: Moving so that others gladly follow — but follow only what is good.
hexagrams.tuan: 隨，剛來而下柔，動而說，隨。大亨貞，无咎，而天下隨時，隨時之義大矣哉！
hexagrams.daxiang: 澤中有雷，隨；君子以嚮晦入宴息。

yao.text: 官有渝，貞吉。出門交有功。
yao.xiang: 官有渝，從正吉也。出門交有功，不失也。

yao.text: 係丈夫，失小子。隨，有求得利，居貞。
隨有獲，貞凶。有孚在道，以明，何咎。
yao.xiang: 隨有獲，其義凶也。有孚在道，明功也。

yao.text: 拘係之，乃從維之。王用亨于西山。

xugua.zh: 豫必有隨，故受之以隨。
xugua.en: Where there is delight there will be followers; therefore Sui follows.

hexagrams.logicZh: 一個人能讓人喜悅，別人就會跟隨他。隨卦兌（悅）在上、震（動）在下：我動而彼悅，所以相隨。 隨也有「隨時」之意——順應時勢變化。但跟隨要擇善而從，卦辭說「元亨利貞，无咎」，跟隨必須以正道為前提。
hexagrams.logicEn: Someone who brings joy draws followers. Sui 隨 is Lake (joy) above Thunder (movement): I move and others are glad, so they follow. Sui also means going along with the times. But one must follow what is good; the judgment's "great success, beneficial to be correct, no blame" makes rightness the condition of following.

hexagrams.name: 蠱
hexagrams.enAlt: Work on What Has Been Spoiled
hexagrams.gistZh: 積弊已生，必須著手整治。
hexagrams.gistEn: Corruption has set in — time to fix what has been spoiled.
hexagrams.judgment: 元亨。利涉大川。先甲三日，後甲三日。
hexagrams.tuan: 蠱，剛上而柔下，巽而止，蠱。蠱，元亨，而天下治也。利涉大川，往有事也。先甲三日，後甲三日，終則有始，天行也。
hexagrams.daxiang: 山下有風，蠱；君子以振民育德。

yao.text: 幹父之蠱，有子考，无咎，厲終吉。
幹父之蠱，小有悔，无大咎。

xugua.zh: 以喜隨人者，必有事，故受之以蠱；蠱者事也。
xugua.en: Those who follow others out of delight are sure to have affairs to deal with; therefore Gu follows. Gu means affairs.

hexagrams.logicZh: 只因喜悅而盲目跟隨，久而久之必生弊端。「蠱」字是器皿中生蟲，意為腐敗積弊；序卦傳解作「事」， 即需要處理的事務。隨與蠱互為綜卦，也互為錯卦：風平浪靜的隨從之後，問題暴露，必須著手整治。 卦辭「先甲三日，後甲三日」，強調整頓要審慎謀劃、承前啟後。
hexagrams.logicEn: Following others merely because it feels good breeds problems over time. The character 蠱 shows worms in a vessel — rot, accumulated corruption; the Xugua glosses it as "affairs," things that must be dealt with. Sui 隨 and Gu 蠱 are both inverted and opposite versions of each other: after easygoing following, the problems surface and must be repaired. "Three days before the starting day, three days after": reform needs careful planning, looking both back and forward.

hexagrams.name: 臨
hexagrams.gistZh: 陽氣漸長，居上臨下，事業壯大。
hexagrams.gistEn: Yang is on the rise — overseeing, growing great.
hexagrams.judgment: 元亨。利貞。至于八月有凶。
hexagrams.tuan: 臨，剛浸而長。說而順，剛中而應，大亨以正，天之道也。至于八月有凶，消不久也。
hexagrams.daxiang: 澤上有地，臨；君子以教思无窮，容保民无疆。

yao.xiang: 咸臨，吉无不利；未順命也。

yao.text: 甘臨，无攸利。既憂之，无咎。
yao.xiang: 甘臨，位不當也。既憂之，咎不長也。

xugua.zh: 有事而后可大，故受之以臨；臨者大也。
xugua.en: Having affairs to manage, one can then become great; therefore Lin follows. Lin means great.

hexagrams.logicZh: 能夠勇於任事、整治弊端，事業才能壯大。「臨」是居高臨下、親臨治理，序卦傳解為「大」。 卦象兩個陽爻自下而上增長，陽氣漸盛，象徵力量日益壯大。但卦辭也提醒「至于八月有凶」——盛長之時要預見衰退。
hexagrams.logicEn: Only by taking on affairs and fixing what is broken can an enterprise grow great. Lin 臨 means approaching from above, overseeing; the Xugua glosses it as "great." Two yang lines grow from the bottom: strength is on the rise. Yet the judgment warns, "in the eighth month there will be misfortune" — in times of growth, foresee decline.

hexagrams.name: 觀
hexagrams.gistZh: 風行地上——在上者為人所瞻仰，也觀照天下。
hexagrams.gistEn: Wind over the earth — being looked up to, and looking out over all.
hexagrams.tuan: 大觀在上，順而巽，中正以觀天下。觀，盥而不薦，有孚顒若，下觀而化也。觀天之神道，而四時不忒，聖人以神道設教，而天下服矣。
hexagrams.daxiang: 風行地上，觀；先王以省方，觀民設教。

xugua.zh: 物大然後可觀，故受之以觀。
xugua.en: When things are great, they can be contemplated; therefore Guan follows.

hexagrams.logicZh: 事物壯大之後，才有可觀之處，值得人們瞻仰；同時居上位者也要觀察天下。觀卦巽（風）行地上， 風吹遍大地，無所不至，象徵觀察與教化。臨與觀互為綜卦：臨是居上而臨下，觀是在上者被下觀仰，也觀照下民—— 治理從力量轉向示範與省察。
hexagrams.logicEn: Once something has grown great it becomes worth beholding, and those above must also observe the world. Guan 觀 is Wind moving over the Earth, reaching everywhere: observation and moral influence. Lin 臨 and Guan 觀 are an inverted pair: in Lin the superior approaches those below; in Guan the superior is looked up to and in turn surveys the people. Rule shifts from power to example and reflection.

hexagrams.name: 噬嗑
hexagrams.gistZh: 口中有物梗阻，咬斷才能合攏——明罰敕法。
hexagrams.gistEn: Something blocks the jaws — bite through it so they can close; law and justice.
hexagrams.tuan: 頤中有物，曰噬嗑，噬嗑而亨。剛柔分，動而明，雷電合而章。柔得中而上行，雖不當位，利用獄也。
hexagrams.daxiang: 雷電噬嗑；先王以明罰敕法。

yao.text: 噬乾胏，得金矢，利艱貞，吉。
噬乾肉，得黃金，貞厲，无咎。

xugua.zh: 可觀而后有所合，故受之以噬嗑；嗑者合也。
xugua.en: Being worth contemplating, there will then be things that come together; therefore Shi He follows. He means closing together.

hexagrams.logicZh: 有可觀之德，人們便想來合。但要真正相合，中間的阻隔必須咬斷。噬嗑卦像張開的嘴（初、上兩陽為唇，中間陰爻為空）， 九四一陽橫梗其中，必須「噬」（咬）掉才能「嗑」（合攏）。所以此卦講刑罰訟獄：清除障礙，才能實現團結。
hexagrams.logicEn: Something worth beholding attracts people who want to come together, but for real union the obstacle in between must be bitten through. The hexagram looks like an open mouth, with yang lines at top and bottom as lips and a yang line in the fourth place stuck between them. It must be bitten (噬) for the jaws to close (嗑). Hence the theme of law and punishment: remove the obstruction to achieve union.

hexagrams.name: 賁
hexagrams.gistZh: 山下有火，草木生輝——以文飾使結合有禮有度。
hexagrams.gistEn: Fire beneath the mountain lights it up — form and beauty give union its order.
hexagrams.tuan: 賁，亨；柔來而文剛，故亨。分剛上而文柔，故小利有攸往。剛柔交錯，天文也；文明以止，人文也。觀乎天文，以察時變；觀乎人文，以化成天下。
hexagrams.daxiang: 山下有火，賁；君子以明庶政，无敢折獄。

yao.text: 賁如皤如，白馬翰如，匪寇婚媾。
yao.xiang: 六四，當位疑也。匪寇婚媾，終无尤也。

yao.text: 賁於丘園，束帛戔戔，吝，終吉。

xugua.zh: 物不可以苟合而已，故受之以賁；賁者飾也。
xugua.en: Things cannot simply come together carelessly; therefore Bi follows. Bi means adornment.

hexagrams.logicZh: 人與人、物與物的結合不能草率隨便，需要禮文加以修飾，使之有秩序、有美感。賁卦艮（山）下有離（火）， 火照山上草木，光彩斑斕。噬嗑與賁互為綜卦：前者以刑罰強制相合，後者以文飾使結合有禮有度——由「刑」轉向「文」。
hexagrams.logicEn: Unions between people or things should not be slapdash; they need cultural form — ritual and grace — to give them order and beauty. Bi 賁 is Fire below the Mountain, lighting the plants on its slopes in brilliant color. Shi He 噬嗑 and Bi 賁 are an inverted pair: one enforces union through punishment, the other refines it through culture — from law to grace.

hexagrams.name: 剝
hexagrams.gistZh: 群陰剝陽，只剩一陽在上——宜靜守，不宜妄動。
hexagrams.gistEn: Yin erodes yang until one line remains — hold still, do not act rashly.
hexagrams.tuan: 剝，剝也，柔變剛也。不利有攸往，小人長也。順而止之，觀象也。君子尚消息盈虛，天行也。
hexagrams.daxiang: 山附地上，剝；上以厚下，安宅。

yao.text: 碩果不食，君子得輿，小人剝廬。
yao.xiang: 君子得輿，民所載也。小人剝廬，終不可用也。

xugua.zh: 致飾然後亨，則盡矣，故受之以剝；剝者剝也。
xugua.en: When adornment is carried to its utmost, success is used up; therefore Bo follows. Bo means stripping away.

hexagrams.logicZh: 文飾若推到極端，徒有其表，內在的真實便耗盡了。過度修飾的結果是剝落、衰敗。剝卦五陰在下、一陽在上， 陰氣自下而上一路侵蝕，只剩最後一個陽爻，如牆皮剝落、房屋將傾。卦辭「不利有攸往」——此時宜靜守，不宜妄動。
hexagrams.logicEn: Push ornament to the extreme and only surface remains; the inner substance is used up. Excessive decoration ends in peeling and decay. Bo 剝 has five yin lines eating upward until only one yang line is left at the top, like plaster flaking off a house about to fall. "It is not beneficial to go anywhere": this is a time to hold still.

hexagrams.name: 復
hexagrams.gistZh: 一陽來復，黑暗最深處孕育光明。
hexagrams.gistEn: One yang line returns — light reborn in the deepest dark.
hexagrams.judgment: 亨。出入无疾，朋來无咎。反復其道，七日來復，利有攸往。
hexagrams.tuan: 復亨；剛反，動而以順行，是以出入无疾，朋來无咎。反復其道，七日來復，天行也。利有攸往，剛長也。復其見天地之心乎？
hexagrams.daxiang: 雷在地中，復；先王以至日閉關，商旅不行，后不省方。

yao.text: 迷復，凶，有災眚。用行師，終有大敗，以其國君，凶；至于十年，不克征。

xugua.zh: 物不可以終盡，剝窮上反下，故受之以復。
xugua.en: Things cannot be used up forever; when stripping reaches the top it returns to the bottom; therefore Fu follows.

hexagrams.logicZh: 這是卦序中最著名的轉折之一。剝到盡頭，最後一個陽爻從上方消失，卻在最下方重新出現——一陽來復。 剝與復互為綜卦，把剝倒轉過來就是復。冬至一陽生，黑暗最深處孕育光明。彖傳說「復，其見天地之心乎」： 生生不息，正是天地的本心。
hexagrams.logicEn: One of the most famous turns in the sequence. When stripping is complete, the last yang line vanishes at the top only to reappear at the bottom: "one yang returns." Bo 剝 and Fu 復 are an inverted pair — turn Bo upside down and you get Fu. At the winter solstice light is reborn in the deepest dark. The Tuan says, "In Fu we see the heart of heaven and earth": ceaseless renewal is the cosmos's own intent.

hexagrams.name: 无妄
hexagrams.gistZh: 真實無偽，動合天理，不作非分之想。
hexagrams.gistEn: Genuine and unfeigned — acting in accord with heaven, wanting nothing improper.
hexagrams.judgment: 元亨。利貞。其匪正有眚，不利有攸往。
hexagrams.tuan: 无妄，剛自外來，而為主於內。動而健，剛中而應，大亨以正，天之命也。其匪正有眚，不利有攸往。无妄之往，何之矣？天命不祐，行矣哉？
hexagrams.daxiang: 天下雷行，物與无妄；先王以茂對時，育萬物。

yao.text: 不耕穫，不菑畬，則利有攸往。
无妄之災，或繫之牛，行人之得，邑人之災。

xugua.zh: 復則不妄矣，故受之以无妄。
xugua.en: With return, there is no more falseness; therefore Wu Wang follows.

hexagrams.logicZh: 回歸本源、恢復正道之後，行為就不再虛妄。「无妄」即真實無偽、不存非分之想。卦象乾（天）在上、震（動）在下—— 動而合乎天理。程頤解為「至誠」。无妄也有「意外」之意：一切順其自然，不刻意妄求，即便遇到「无妄之災」也不必驚慌。
hexagrams.logicEn: Having returned to the source and the right way, one's actions are no longer false. Wu Wang 无妄 means genuine, without pretense or improper desire. Heaven above Thunder: movement in accord with heaven's pattern. Cheng Yi reads it as utmost sincerity. It also suggests the unexpected: act naturally, scheme for nothing, and even an "unforeseen calamity" need not throw you.

hexagrams.name: 大畜
hexagrams.gistZh: 天在山中——蓄德深厚，多識前言往行。
hexagrams.gistEn: Heaven held within the mountain — a deep store of virtue and learning.
hexagrams.judgment: 利貞，不家食吉，利涉大川。
hexagrams.tuan: 大畜，剛健篤實輝光，日新其德，剛上而尚賢。能止健，大正也。不家食吉，養賢也。利涉大川，應乎天也。
hexagrams.daxiang: 天在山中，大畜；君子以多識前言往行，以畜其德。

yao.text: 良馬逐，利艱貞，吉。日閑輿衛，利有攸往。

xugua.zh: 有无妄然後可畜，故受之以大畜。
xugua.en: Having no falseness, one can then accumulate; therefore Da Xu follows.

hexagrams.logicZh: 真誠無妄，才能積蓄真正的德行和實力。大畜卦艮（山）在上、乾（天）在下：天被包容在山中，比喻蓄積之大。 與小畜相比，小畜是一陰畜五陽，力量有限；大畜則是艮山以剛止健，畜得穩固而深厚。无妄與大畜互為綜卦。 象傳說：「君子以多識前言往行，以畜其德。」
hexagrams.logicEn: Only genuine sincerity lets real virtue and strength be stored up. Da Xu 大畜 is Mountain above Heaven: heaven itself held within the mountain, an image of vast accumulation. In Xiao Xu 小畜 (9) a single yin line restrains five yang; here the firm mountain contains the strong, making a solid, deep store. Wu Wang 无妄 and Da Xu 大畜 are an inverted pair. "The superior person learns many sayings and deeds of the past to build up virtue."

hexagrams.name: 頤
hexagrams.gistZh: 張口之象——觀其所養，便知其人。
hexagrams.gistEn: An open mouth — how one nourishes self and others reveals character.
hexagrams.tuan: 頤貞吉，養正則吉也。觀頤，觀其所養也；自求口實，觀其自養也。天地養萬物，聖人養賢，以及萬民；頤之時大矣哉！
hexagrams.daxiang: 山下有雷，頤；君子以慎言語，節飲食。

yao.text: 拂頤，貞凶，十年勿用，无攸利。
顛頤吉，虎視眈眈，其欲逐逐，无咎。
拂經，居貞吉，不可涉大川。

xugua.zh: 物畜然後可養，故受之以頤；頤者養也。
xugua.en: When things have been accumulated, they can be nourished; therefore Yi follows. Yi means nourishing.

hexagrams.logicZh: 有了積蓄，才能養育——養身，也養德。「頤」本指臉頰、下巴，卦形正像張開的口：上下兩陽爻是上下顎， 中間四陰爻是口腔。卦辭「觀頤，自求口實」，提醒人看一個人如何養己養人，便知其品格。頤與大過是一對錯卦（六爻全反）。
hexagrams.logicEn: Once there are stores, there can be nourishment — of body and of virtue. Yi 頤 originally means the jaws, and the hexagram looks like an open mouth: yang lines top and bottom as the jaws, four yin lines as the hollow between. "Observe the jaws, and what one seeks to fill one's mouth with": how people nourish themselves and others reveals their character. Yi 頤 and Da Guo 大過 are a complementary pair (every line inverted).

hexagrams.name: 大過
hexagrams.gistZh: 棟樑中重而兩端弱——非常之時，行非常之事。
hexagrams.gistEn: A sagging ridgepole — extraordinary times call for extraordinary action.
hexagrams.tuan: 大過，大者過也。棟橈，本末弱也。剛過而中，巽而說行，利有攸往，乃亨。大過之時大矣哉！
hexagrams.daxiang: 澤滅木，大過。君子以獨立不懼，遯世无悶。

yao.text: 枯楊生稊，老夫得其女妻，无不利。

yao.xiang: 棟橈之凶，不可以有輔也。

yao.text: 枯楊生華，老婦得其士夫，无咎无譽。
yao.xiang: 枯楊生華，何可久也。老婦士夫，亦可醜也。

xugua.zh: 不養則不可動，故受之以大過。
xugua.en: Without nourishment one cannot act; therefore Da Guo follows.

hexagrams.logicZh: 有養才能有所作為，養得充足就能做出非常之事。「大過」是大的過度——陽剛過盛：四個陽爻擠在中間， 兩端陰爻柔弱，如同「棟橈」，屋樑中間粗重而兩端不勝負荷。這是非常時期，需要非常之舉； 象傳說「君子以獨立不懼，遯世无悶」。
hexagrams.logicEn: Only the nourished can act, and with ample nourishment one can do extraordinary things. Da Guo 大過 is great excess, too much yang: four strong lines crowd the middle while the weak ends cannot bear them, like "a ridgepole that sags." It is an extraordinary time calling for extraordinary action: "the superior person stands alone without fear, and withdraws from the world without regret."

hexagrams.name: 坎
hexagrams.gistZh: 重重險陷；行險而不失其信。
hexagrams.gistEn: Danger upon danger — move through it without losing faith.
hexagrams.tuan: 習坎，重險也。水流而不盈，行險而不失其信。維心亨，乃以剛中也。行有尚，往有功也。天險不可升也，地險山川丘陵也，王公設險以守其國，坎之時用大矣哉！
hexagrams.daxiang: 水洊至，習坎；君子以常德行，習教事。

yao.text: 來之坎坎，險且枕，入于坎窞，勿用。
樽酒簋貳，用缶，納約自牖，終无咎。
係用徽纆，寘于叢棘，三歲不得，凶。

xugua.zh: 物不可以終過，故受之以坎；坎者陷也。
xugua.en: Things cannot be in excess forever; therefore Kan follows. Kan means a pit.

hexagrams.logicZh: 過度之後必然陷入險境。坎為水、為陷，上下皆坎，重重險難，所以又名「習坎」。但坎卦也教人如何處險： 水流不止、不失其信——一陽居中，內心剛實，就能「維心亨」。在危難中保持誠信與恆心，才能出險。
hexagrams.logicEn: Excess inevitably leads into danger. Kan 坎 is water, a pit; doubled, it is danger upon danger, hence the name "repeated Kan." Yet it also teaches how to live with danger: water keeps flowing without losing its way, and a yang line stays firm at the center, so "holding to the heart brings success." Keep faith and persistence amid peril, and you will come through.

hexagrams.name: 離
hexagrams.gistZh: 火附薪而明，日月麗天——有所依附而生光明。
hexagrams.gistEn: Fire clings to fuel, sun and moon to the sky — attachment that gives light.
hexagrams.tuan: 離，麗也；日月麗乎天，百穀草木麗乎土，重明以麗乎正，乃化成天下。柔麗乎中正，故亨；是以畜牝牛吉也。
hexagrams.daxiang: 明兩作離，大人以繼明照于四方。

yao.text: 日昃之離，不鼓缶而歌，則大耋之嗟，凶。
突如其來如，焚如，死如，棄如。
王用出征，有嘉折首，獲匪其醜，无咎。

xugua.zh: 陷必有所麗，故受之以離；離者麗也。
xugua.en: Falling into a pit, one must cling to something; therefore Li follows. Li means clinging.

hexagrams.logicZh: 陷入險境，必須有所依附才能脫困。「離」解作「麗」，即附著——如火附著於薪柴而燃燒、日月附著於天而光明。 坎與離是錯卦：坎外柔內剛，陷而中實；離外剛內柔，明而中虛。上經以坎離作結：水火是天地之間最大的作用力， 也象徵月與日，與開頭的乾坤（天地）首尾呼應。
hexagrams.logicEn: Having fallen into danger, one must cling to something to get out. The Xugua glosses Li 離 as 麗, "attaching" — as fire clings to fuel to burn, and sun and moon cling to the sky to shine. Kan 坎 and Li 離 are complementary opposites: Kan is soft outside and firm within; Li is firm outside and empty within. The Upper Canon ends with water and fire, the great active forces between heaven and earth, also the moon and sun — answering Qian and Kun (heaven and earth) at its opening.

hexagrams.name: 咸
hexagrams.gistZh: 少男少女，無心之感；下經從人倫開始。
hexagrams.gistEn: Young man and young woman, spontaneous attraction — the Lower Canon begins with human bonds.
hexagrams.tuan: 咸，感也。柔上而剛下，二氣感應以相與，止而說，男下女，是以亨利貞，取女吉也。天地感而萬物化生，聖人感人心而天下和平；觀其所感，而天地萬物之情可見矣！
hexagrams.daxiang: 山上有澤，咸；君子以虛受人。

yao.xiang: 咸其股，亦不處也。志在隨人，所執下也。

yao.text: 貞吉悔亡，憧憧往來，朋從爾思。
yao.xiang: 貞吉悔亡，未感害也。憧憧往來，未光大也。

xugua.zh: 有天地然後有萬物，有萬物然後有男女，有男女然後有夫婦，有夫婦然後有父子，有父子然後有君臣，有君臣然後有上下，有上下然後禮儀有所錯。
xugua.en: There are heaven and earth, and then the myriad things; there are the myriad things, and then male and female; male and female, then husband and wife; husband and wife, then father and son; father and son, then ruler and minister; ruler and minister, then high and low; and when there are high and low, ritual and righteousness have their place.

hexagrams.logicZh: 下經重新從「天地」說起，但很快轉向人倫：男女→夫婦→父子→君臣→上下→禮義，整個社會秩序都根源於夫婦。 咸卦兌（少女）在上、艮（少男）在下；彖傳說「咸，感也」，傳統解釋「咸」是「感」去掉「心」，代表無心之感、 自然的相互感應。上經以天地開篇，下經以男女感應開篇：先講天道，再講人道。和乾坤一樣，序卦傳在這段話中 沒有寫出「咸」字，而是讓整段話引出它。
hexagrams.logicEn: The Lower Canon starts again from heaven and earth but turns at once to human relationships: male and female → husband and wife → parent and child → ruler and minister → high and low → ritual. All social order grows from the bond of husband and wife. Xian 咸 puts Lake (the youngest daughter) above Mountain (the youngest son). The Tuan says "Xian means feeling," and tradition notes that 咸 is 感 (feeling) without the heart 心 — spontaneous, unwilled response. The Upper Canon opens with heaven and earth, the Lower with the attraction of man and woman: the way of heaven, then the way of humans. As with Qian and Kun, the passage never names Xian; the whole sentence leads up to it.

hexagrams.name: 恆
hexagrams.gistZh: 雷風相與，持久不息；在變化中守正。
hexagrams.gistEn: Thunder and wind together, lasting — holding a steady course through change.
hexagrams.tuan: 恆，久也。剛上而柔下，雷風相與，巽而動，剛柔皆應，恆。恆亨无咎，利貞；久于其道也，天地之道，恆久而不已也。利有攸往，終則有始也。日月得天，而能久照，四時變化，而能久成，聖人久于其道，而天下化成；觀其所恆，而天地萬物之情可見矣！
hexagrams.daxiang: 雷風，恆；君子以立不易方。

yao.text: 不恆其德，或承之羞，貞吝。
恆其德，貞，婦人吉，夫子凶。
yao.xiang: 婦人貞吉，從一而終也。夫子制義，從婦凶也。

xugua.zh: 夫婦之道，不可以不久也，故受之以恆；恆者久也。
xugua.en: The way of husband and wife cannot but endure; therefore Heng follows. Heng means lasting.

hexagrams.logicZh: 夫婦的感情始於相互感應，但必須長久維持。咸與恆互為綜卦：咸是少男在少女之下，追求、感應的熱戀階段； 恆是長男（震）在上、長女（巽）在下，各安其位的婚姻生活。雷風相與，動而不息。 恆不是靜止不變，而是在變化中持守正道。
hexagrams.logicEn: Marriage begins with mutual attraction but must be sustained. Xian 咸 and Heng 恆 are an inverted pair: in Xian the young man defers to the young woman — courtship, the spark; in Heng the eldest son (Thunder) is above and the eldest daughter (Wind) below — settled married life with each in place. Thunder and wind work together, moving ceaselessly. Constancy is not standing still but holding a right course through change.

hexagrams.name: 遯
hexagrams.gistZh: 陰長陽消，君子及時退避，保存實力。
hexagrams.gistEn: Yin advances — the wise withdraw in time and preserve their strength.
hexagrams.tuan: 遯亨，遯而亨也。剛當位而應，與時行也。小利貞，浸而長也。遯之時義大矣哉！
hexagrams.daxiang: 天下有山，遯；君子以遠小人，不惡而嚴。

yao.text: 執之用黃牛之革，莫之勝說。

yao.xiang: 係遯之厲，有疾憊也。畜臣妾吉，不可大事也。

xugua.zh: 物不可以久居其所，故受之以遯；遯者退也。
xugua.en: Things cannot stay in their place for long; therefore Dun follows. Dun means withdrawing.

hexagrams.logicZh: 恆講長久，但事物不可能永遠停留在同一位置，時勢變化就要知所進退。遯卦二陰自下而上增長，陰長陽消， 小人勢力漸盛，君子應當及時退避。退不是逃避，而是保存實力、等待時機——象傳說「君子以遠小人，不惡而嚴」。
hexagrams.logicEn: Heng 恆 is about lasting, but nothing can stay in one place forever; when circumstances change you must know when to step back. In Dun 遯 two yin lines grow from below — yin waxing, yang waning, petty forces gaining ground — and the superior person should withdraw in time. Retreat is not escape but preserving strength and waiting: "keep petty people at a distance, not with hatred but with dignity."

hexagrams.name: 大壯
hexagrams.gistZh: 雷在天上，聲勢浩大；強盛更要守正。
hexagrams.gistEn: Thunder in the sky — great power, which must stay upright.
hexagrams.tuan: 大壯，大者壯也。剛以動，故壯。大壯利貞；大者正也。正大而天地之情可見矣！
hexagrams.daxiang: 雷在天上，大壯；君子以非禮弗履。

yao.text: 小人用壯，君子用罔，貞厲。羝羊觸藩，羸其角。
貞吉悔亡，藩決不羸，壯于大輿之輹。
羝羊觸藩，不能退，不能遂，无攸利，艱則吉。
yao.xiang: 不能退，不能遂，不詳也。艱則吉，咎不長也。

xugua.zh: 物不可終遯，故受之以大壯。
xugua.en: Things cannot withdraw forever; therefore Da Zhuang follows.

hexagrams.logicZh: 退避不能是永遠的，退到一定程度就會重新壯大。遯與大壯互為綜卦：遯是二陰長而陽退；大壯是四陽長、陽氣強盛， 雷在天上，聲勢浩大。但壯盛之時最易恃強妄動，卦辭只說「利貞」，象傳說「君子以非禮弗履」——強大更要守正。
hexagrams.logicEn: Retreat cannot last forever; at some point strength builds again. Dun 遯 and Da Zhuang 大壯 are an inverted pair: in Dun yin grows and yang retreats; in Da Zhuang four yang lines have grown — thunder in the sky, mighty and loud. But power tempts reckless action, so the judgment says only "beneficial to be correct," and the Image adds, "the superior person does not tread where propriety forbids."

hexagrams.name: 晉
hexagrams.gistZh: 旭日東昇，光明漸進，步步高升。
hexagrams.gistEn: The sun rises over the earth — steady, bright advance.
hexagrams.judgment: 康侯用錫馬蕃庶，晝日三接。
hexagrams.tuan: 晉，進也。明出地上，順而麗乎大明，柔進而上行。是以康侯用錫馬蕃庶，晝日三接也。
hexagrams.daxiang: 明出地上，晉；君子以自昭明德。

yao.text: 晉如，摧如，貞吉。罔孚，裕无咎。
yao.xiang: 晉如，摧如；獨行正也。裕无咎；未受命也。

yao.text: 晉如，愁如，貞吉。受茲介福，于其王母。
悔亡，失得勿恤，往吉无不利。
晉其角，維用伐邑，厲吉无咎，貞吝。

xugua.zh: 物不可以終壯，故受之以晉；晉者進也。
xugua.en: Things cannot stay at full strength forever; therefore Jin follows. Jin means advancing.

hexagrams.logicZh: 壯盛不能停滯不動，力量必須轉化為前進。晉卦離（日）出地上，旭日東昇，光明漸進。程頤認為事物壯盛之後必然前進， 所以晉接在大壯之後。卦辭描繪臣子受君主賞識、步步高升：「康侯用錫馬蕃庶，晝日三接。」
hexagrams.logicEn: Strength cannot simply stand still; it must turn into advance. Jin 晉 is the Sun rising over the Earth: dawn, light steadily advancing. Cheng Yi explains that what has grown strong must move forward, which is why Jin follows Da Zhuang 大壯. The judgment pictures a minister honored and promoted by the ruler: "the marquis is given many horses and received three times in a single day."

hexagrams.name: 明夷
hexagrams.gistZh: 日入地中，光明受傷——用晦而明，艱難守正。
hexagrams.gistEn: The sun sinks into the earth — hide your light and stay true in hard times.
hexagrams.tuan: 明入地中，明夷。內文明而外柔順，以蒙大難，文王以之。利艱貞，晦其明也，內難而能正其志，箕子以之。
hexagrams.daxiang: 明入地中，明夷；君子以蒞眾，用晦而明。

yao.text: 明夷于飛，垂其翼。君子于行，三日不食，有攸往，主人有言。
明夷，夷于左股，用拯馬壯，吉。
明夷于南狩，得其大首，不可疾貞。
入于左腹，獲明夷之心，于出門庭。
不明晦，初登于天，後入于地。
yao.xiang: 初登于天，照四國也。後入于地，失則也。

xugua.zh: 進必有所傷，故受之以明夷；夷者傷也。
xugua.en: Advance is sure to meet with injury; therefore Ming Yi follows. Yi means wounding.

hexagrams.logicZh: 一味前進，必然遭遇挫傷。晉與明夷互為綜卦：晉是日出地上，明夷是日入地中，光明被遮蔽、受傷害。 這是賢者處於昏暗時代的處境，如文王被囚、箕子佯狂。卦辭「利艱貞」，象傳說「用晦而明」：外表隱晦、內心光明， 在逆境中保全自己。
hexagrams.logicEn: Relentless advance is bound to be hurt. Jin 晉 and Ming Yi 明夷 are an inverted pair: the sun rising over the earth, then the sun sinking into it — light hidden and wounded. This is the worthy person in a dark age, like King Wen imprisoned or Jizi feigning madness. "Beneficial to be steadfast in hardship"; the Image says to "use darkness to remain bright": dim your light outwardly, keep it bright within, and survive adversity.

hexagrams.name: 家人
hexagrams.gistZh: 回到家中；家道正，則天下定。
hexagrams.gistEn: Coming home — set the family right, and the world is settled.
hexagrams.tuan: 家人，女正位乎內，男正位乎外，男女正，天地之大義也。家人有嚴君焉，父母之謂也。父父，子子，兄兄，弟弟，夫夫，婦婦，而家道正；正家而天下定矣。
hexagrams.daxiang: 風自火出，家人；君子以言有物，而行有恆。

yao.text: 家人嗃嗃，悔厲吉；婦子嘻嘻，終吝。
yao.xiang: 家人嗃嗃，未失也；婦子嘻嘻，失家節也。

xugua.zh: 傷於外者，必反其家，故受之以家人。
xugua.en: Those wounded abroad are sure to return home; therefore Jia Ren follows.

hexagrams.logicZh: 在外受了傷，人自然會回到家中尋求庇護與療癒。家人卦講治家之道：六二居內卦之中，九五居外卦之中， 彖傳說「男女正，天地之大義也」。家是社會的基本單位，家道正則天下定——故事從個人的挫折轉回最根本的人倫關係。
hexagrams.logicEn: Wounded in the outside world, a person naturally comes home for shelter and healing. Jia Ren 家人 is about ordering the household: a yin line centered within (second place), a yang line centered without (fifth place). The Tuan says, "When man and woman are in their proper places, that is the great principle of heaven and earth." The family is the basic unit of society; set it right and the world is settled. From personal setback the story turns back to the most basic human bond.

hexagrams.name: 睽
hexagrams.gistZh: 火上澤下，背道而馳；異中求同。
hexagrams.gistEn: Fire rises, water sinks — estrangement, yet common ground within difference.
hexagrams.tuan: 睽，火動而上，澤動而下；二女同居，其志不同行；說而麗乎明，柔進而上行，得中而應乎剛；是以小事吉。天地睽，而其事同也；男女睽，而其志通也；萬物睽，而其事類也；睽之時用大矣哉！
hexagrams.daxiang: 上火下澤，睽；君子以同而異。

yao.text: 悔亡，喪馬勿逐，自復；見惡人无咎。
見輿曳，其牛掣，其人天且劓，无初有終。
yao.xiang: 見輿曳，位不當也。无初有終，遇剛也。

yao.text: 睽孤，遇元夫，交孚，厲无咎。
睽孤，見豕負塗，載鬼一車，先張之弧，後說之弧，匪寇婚媾，往遇雨則吉。

xugua.zh: 家道窮必乖，故受之以睽；睽者乖也。
xugua.en: When the way of the family is exhausted, estrangement is sure to follow; therefore Kui follows. Kui means estrangement.

hexagrams.logicZh: 家道一旦衰落，家人之間就會離心離德、彼此乖違。家人與睽互為綜卦。睽卦離（火）在上、兌（澤）在下： 火往上燒，水往下流，背道而馳；又是中女、少女同居一處，「其志不同行」。但彖傳指出「天地睽而其事同也」—— 差異之中仍可求同，小事仍然吉。
hexagrams.logicEn: When the household's way runs down, its members drift apart and turn against each other. Jia Ren 家人 and Kui 睽 are an inverted pair. Kui is Fire above Lake: fire burns upward, water seeps downward, moving apart; it is also two sisters living together whose "wills do not go the same way." Yet the Tuan observes that "heaven and earth are opposed, yet their work is the same": common ground can be found within difference, and small matters still go well.

hexagrams.name: 蹇
hexagrams.gistZh: 前有水，後有山，進退兩難；反身修德。
hexagrams.gistEn: Water ahead, mountain behind — stuck; turn inward and cultivate yourself.
hexagrams.judgment: 利西南，不利東北；利見大人，貞吉。
hexagrams.tuan: 蹇，難也，險在前也。見險而能止，知矣哉！蹇利西南，往得中也；不利東北，其道窮也。利見大人，往有功也。當位貞吉，以正邦也。蹇之時用大矣哉！
hexagrams.daxiang: 山上有水，蹇；君子以反身修德。

yao.xiang: 往蹇來碩，志在內也。利見大人，以從貴也。

xugua.zh: 乖必有難，故受之以蹇；蹇者難也。
xugua.en: Estrangement is sure to bring hardship; therefore Jian follows. Jian means difficulty.

hexagrams.logicZh: 人心乖離，必然陷入困境。「蹇」本義是跛腳、行走艱難。卦象坎（險）在前、艮（山）在後——前有大水、後有高山， 進退兩難。卦辭「利見大人」，象傳說「君子以反身修德」：遇到困難時先反省自己，並尋求賢人的幫助。
hexagrams.logicEn: When hearts are estranged, difficulties follow. Jian 蹇 originally means lame, walking with difficulty. Water (danger) lies ahead and the Mountain behind — a river in front, a mountain at your back, stuck either way. "Beneficial to see the great person"; and the Image: "the superior person turns back to cultivate virtue." In hardship, first examine yourself, then seek the help of the wise.

hexagrams.name: 解
hexagrams.gistZh: 雷雨交作，冰雪消融——險難解除，及時復常。
hexagrams.gistEn: A spring storm breaks the winter — danger released; return to normal promptly.
hexagrams.judgment: 利西南，无所往，其來復吉。有攸往，夙吉。
hexagrams.tuan: 解，險以動，動而免乎險，解。解利西南，往得眾也。其來復吉，乃得中也。有攸往夙吉，往有功也。天地解，而雷雨作，雷雨作，而百果草木皆甲坼，解之時義大矣哉！
hexagrams.daxiang: 雷雨作，解；君子以赦過宥罪。

yao.xiang: 負且乘，亦可醜也，自我致戎，又誰咎也。

yao.text: 君子維有解，吉；有孚于小人。
公用射隼，于高墉之上，獲之，无不利。

xugua.zh: 物不可終難，故受之以解；解者緩也。
xugua.en: Things cannot be in difficulty forever; therefore Xie follows. Xie means relief.

hexagrams.logicZh: 困難不會永遠持續，終將迎來解脫。蹇與解互為綜卦：蹇是止於險前，解是動而出險——震（雷）在上、坎（雨）在下， 雷雨交作，萬物舒展，冬去春來。「緩」是緊張後的鬆弛。卦辭「无所往，其來復吉；有攸往，夙吉」： 危機解除後要及時恢復常態，還有事就要早辦。
hexagrams.logicEn: Hardship does not last forever; release comes. Jian 蹇 and Xie 解 are an inverted pair: Jian halts before danger, Xie moves out of it — Thunder above Rain, a spring storm that loosens everything after winter. "Relief" is the slackening after tension. The judgment advises returning to normal once the crisis passes, and dealing promptly with whatever remains.

hexagrams.name: 損
hexagrams.gistZh: 損下益上；減少慾望與浪費，誠則簡亦足。
hexagrams.gistEn: Decreasing below to increase above — less desire, less waste; sincerity makes simplicity enough.
hexagrams.judgment: 有孚，元吉。无咎，可貞，利有攸往。曷之用？二簋可用享。
hexagrams.tuan: 損，損下益上，其道上行。損而有孚，元吉，无咎，可貞，利有攸往。曷之用？二簋可用享；二簋應有時。損剛益柔有時，損益盈虛，與時偕行。
hexagrams.daxiang: 山下有澤，損；君子以懲忿窒欲。

yao.text: 三人行，則損一人；一人行，則得其友。
或益之，十朋之龜弗克違，元吉。
弗損益之，无咎，貞吉，利有攸往，得臣无家。

xugua.zh: 緩必有所失，故受之以損。
xugua.en: Slackening is sure to bring loss; therefore Sun follows.

hexagrams.logicZh: 鬆懈下來，難免有所損失。但損卦的深意在於「損下益上」——下卦原本是乾，減去一陽給上卦，成了兌下艮上。 有時減少正是必要的：減少忿怒、慾望與浪費，象傳說「君子以懲忿窒欲」。卦辭「二簋可用享」：只要心誠，簡樸也足以祭祀。
hexagrams.logicEn: Once things slacken, some loss is unavoidable. But Sun 損's deeper meaning is "decreasing below to increase above": the lower trigram was Heaven, gave one yang line to the upper, and so became Lake below Mountain. Sometimes decrease is exactly what is needed — less anger, desire and waste: "the superior person restrains anger and curbs desire." "Two simple bowls suffice for the offering": with sincerity, simplicity is enough.

hexagrams.name: 益
hexagrams.gistZh: 損上益下；真正的增益來自給予。
hexagrams.gistEn: Decreasing above to increase below — real gain comes from giving.
hexagrams.tuan: 益，損上益下，民說无疆，自上下下，其道大光。利有攸往，中正有慶。利涉大川，木道乃行。益動而巽，日進无疆。天施地生，其益无方。凡益之道，與時偕行。
hexagrams.daxiang: 風雷，益；君子以見善則遷，有過則改。

yao.text: 或益之，十朋之龜弗克違，永貞吉。王用享于帝，吉。
益之用凶事，无咎。有孚中行，告公用圭。
中行，告公從。利用為依遷國。
有孚惠心，勿問元吉。有孚惠我德。
yao.xiang: 有孚惠心，勿問之矣。惠我德，大得志也。

yao.text: 莫益之，或擊之，立心勿恆，凶。
yao.xiang: 莫益之，偏辭也。或擊之，自外來也。

xugua.zh: 損而不已，必益，故受之以益。
xugua.en: When decrease goes on without end, increase is sure to follow; therefore Yi follows.

hexagrams.logicZh: 減損到了極點，必然轉為增益——損與益互為綜卦，循環往復。益卦是「損上益下」：在上者減損自己來增益百姓， 這才是真正的「益」，所以彖傳說「民說无疆」。這是深刻的政治與人生道理：真正的增益來自給予，而非攫取。
hexagrams.logicEn: Decrease carried to its limit turns into increase: Sun 損 and Yi 益 are an inverted pair that cycle into each other. Yi is "decreasing above to increase below": those on top reduce themselves to benefit the people, and that is true increase — "the people's joy is boundless." A deep principle for politics and life alike: real gain comes from giving, not taking.

hexagrams.name: 夬
hexagrams.gistZh: 五陽決一陰——公開、誠信地決斷，不恃武力。
hexagrams.gistEn: Five yang push out one yin — act decisively, openly and without force.
hexagrams.judgment: 揚于王庭，孚號，有厲，告自邑，不利即戎，利有攸往。
hexagrams.tuan: 夬，決也，剛決柔也。健而說，決而和，揚于王庭，柔乘五剛也。孚號有厲，其危乃光也。告自邑，不利即戎，所尚乃窮也。利有攸往，剛長乃終也。
hexagrams.daxiang: 澤上于天，夬；君子以施祿及下，居德則忌。

yao.text: 壯于頄，有凶。君子夬夬，獨行遇雨，若濡有慍，无咎。
臀无膚，其行次且。牽羊悔亡，聞言不信。
yao.xiang: 其行次且，位不當也。聞言不信，聰不明也。

xugua.zh: 益而不已，必決，故受之以夬；夬者決也。
xugua.en: When increase goes on without end, a breakthrough is sure to come; therefore Guai follows. Guai means breaking through.

hexagrams.logicZh: 增益不止，就像水位不斷上漲，終會決堤。夬卦五陽在下、一陰在上，陽氣盛長到極點，要把最後一個陰爻決除—— 象徵君子去除小人。但卦辭強調「揚于王庭，孚號有厲」：要公開、誠信地處理，而不是以武力取勝（「不利即戎」）。
hexagrams.logicEn: Unchecked increase is like water rising until the dyke bursts. Guai 夬 has five yang lines below a single yin: yang has grown to its peak and is about to push out the last yin — the superior person removing a petty one. But the judgment insists on doing it openly and sincerely, "proclaimed at the king's court," not by force: "it is not beneficial to take up arms."

hexagrams.name: 姤
hexagrams.gistZh: 一陰生於下，不期而遇；慎防微小之始。
hexagrams.gistEn: One yin appears below, an unexpected meeting — watch small beginnings.
hexagrams.tuan: 姤，遇也，柔遇剛也。勿用取女，不可與長也。天地相遇，品物咸章也。剛遇中正，天下大行也。姤之時義大矣哉！
hexagrams.daxiang: 天下有風，姤；后以施命誥四方。

yao.text: 繫于金柅，貞吉，有攸往，見凶，羸豕，孚，蹢躅。
臀无膚，其行次且，厲，无大咎。
以杞包瓜，含章，有隕自天。
yao.xiang: 九五含章，中正也。有隕自天，志不舍命也。

xugua.zh: 決必有所遇，故受之以姤；姤者遇也。
xugua.en: A breakthrough is sure to lead to an encounter; therefore Gou follows. Gou means meeting.

hexagrams.logicZh: 決斷分離之後，必有新的相遇。夬與姤互為綜卦：夬是最後一陰將被去除，姤則是一陰在最下方重新出現—— 陰氣回來了，與五陽「不期而遇」。這與剝、復的結構完全對稱，只是陰陽互換。卦辭「女壯，勿用取女」， 警惕陰柔勢力在細微之處滋長。
hexagrams.logicEn: After parting comes a new encounter. Guai 夬 and Gou 姤 are an inverted pair: in Guai the last yin is about to be expelled; in Gou a single yin reappears at the bottom — yin is back, meeting five yang unexpectedly. Structurally it mirrors Bo 剝 and Fu 復 (23–24) with yin and yang swapped. "The woman is strong; do not marry such a woman": beware the small beginnings of a growing force.

hexagrams.name: 萃
hexagrams.gistZh: 澤在地上，眾水匯聚；聚眾須有中心，也須防變。
hexagrams.gistEn: A lake over the earth, waters collecting — a gathering needs a center and vigilance.
hexagrams.judgment: 王假有廟，利見大人，亨。利貞。用大牲吉，利有攸往。
hexagrams.tuan: 萃，聚也；順以說，剛中而應，故聚也。王假有廟，致孝享也。利見大人亨，聚以正也。用大牲吉，利有攸往，順天命也。觀其所聚，而天地萬物之情可見矣。
hexagrams.daxiang: 澤上于地，萃；君子以除戎器，戒不虞。

yao.text: 有孚不終，乃亂乃萃，若號一握為笑，勿恤，往无咎。
萃如，嗟如，无攸利，往无咎，小吝。
萃有位，无咎。匪孚，元永貞，悔亡。

xugua.zh: 物相遇而后聚，故受之以萃；萃者聚也。
xugua.en: When things meet, they then gather; therefore Cui follows. Cui means gathering.

hexagrams.logicZh: 相遇之後，便聚集成群。萃卦兌（澤）在地上，水匯聚成澤；九五、九四兩陽為眾陰所歸。聚集需要中心和凝聚力， 卦辭「王假有廟」——以宗廟祭祀凝聚人心。象傳提醒「除戎器，戒不虞」：人多的地方易生變亂，要預防意外。
hexagrams.logicEn: After meeting, things gather into groups. Cui 萃 is Lake over the Earth, water collecting into a marsh; the yang lines in the fifth and fourth places draw the yin lines to them. A gathering needs a center: "the king approaches his temple," uniting hearts through shared ritual. The Image warns to "repair weapons and guard against the unforeseen": crowds breed unrest.

hexagrams.name: 升
hexagrams.gistZh: 木生地中，日日向上；積小以成高大。
hexagrams.gistEn: A tree grows up from the earth — small steps add up to great height.
hexagrams.judgment: 元亨，用見大人，勿恤，南征吉。
hexagrams.tuan: 柔以時升，巽而順，剛中而應，是以大亨。用見大人，勿恤；有慶也。南征吉，志行也。
hexagrams.daxiang: 地中生木，升；君子以順德，積小以高大。

xugua.zh: 聚而上者，謂之升，故受之以升。
xugua.en: Gathering and rising upward is called ascending; therefore Sheng follows.

hexagrams.logicZh: 聚集起來的力量向上發展，就是上升。萃與升互為綜卦。升卦巽（木）在坤（地）下，樹木從地中生長，日日向上， 象傳說「君子以順德，積小以高大」。這種上升是順勢、漸進的，不靠強力，而是一步一步累積而成。
hexagrams.logicEn: Gathered energy that moves upward is ascent. Cui 萃 and Sheng 升 are an inverted pair. Sheng is Wood beneath the Earth: a tree growing up out of the ground day by day — "the superior person follows virtue, piling up small things to become high and great." This rise is gradual and goes with the grain; it is built step by step, not forced.

hexagrams.name: 困
hexagrams.gistZh: 澤中無水，窮困窘迫；困境考驗人格。
hexagrams.gistEn: A lake without water — in dire straits, character is tested.
hexagrams.judgment: 亨，貞大人吉，无咎，有言不信。
hexagrams.tuan: 困，剛掩也。險以說，困而不失其所，亨；其唯君子乎？貞大人吉，以剛中也。有言不信，尚口乃窮也。
hexagrams.daxiang: 澤无水，困；君子以致命遂志。

yao.text: 臀困于株木，入于幽谷，三歲不覿。
困于酒食，朱紱方來，利用亨祀，征凶，无咎。
困于石，據于蒺藜，入于其宮，不見其妻，凶。
yao.xiang: 據于蒺藜，乘剛也。入于其宮，不見其妻，不祥也。

yao.text: 來徐徐，困于金車，吝，有終。
yao.xiang: 來徐徐，志在下也。雖不當位，有與也。

yao.text: 劓刖，困于赤紱，乃徐有說，利用祭祀。
yao.xiang: 劓刖，志未得也。乃徐有說，以中直也。利用祭祀，受福也。

yao.text: 困于葛藟，于臲卼，曰動悔。有悔，征吉。
yao.xiang: 困于葛藟，未當也。動悔，有悔，吉行也。

xugua.zh: 升而不已，必困，故受之以困。
xugua.en: Ascending without stopping, one is sure to be exhausted; therefore Kun follows.

hexagrams.logicZh: 一味上升不知止，終將力竭受困。困卦兌（澤）在上、坎（水）在下——「澤无水」，澤中的水漏到下面去了，乾涸窘迫。 剛爻被陰爻所掩蔽，君子處困。但卦辭說「亨，貞，大人吉」：困境是對人格的考驗；象傳說「君子以致命遂志」， 即使付出生命也要實現志向。
hexagrams.logicEn: Rising without knowing when to stop ends in exhaustion. Kun 困 is Lake above Water — "the lake without water": the water has drained out below, leaving it dry. Firm lines are hemmed in by yielding ones; the superior person is in straits. Yet the judgment says "success; steadfastness; good fortune for the great person": hardship tests character. "The superior person stakes their life to fulfill their will."

hexagrams.name: 井
hexagrams.gistZh: 改邑不改井——回歸根本，養人無窮。
hexagrams.gistEn: The town may move but the well stays — back to the source that feeds everyone.
hexagrams.judgment: 改邑不改井，无喪无得，往來井井。汔至亦未繘井。羸其瓶，凶。
hexagrams.tuan: 巽乎水而上水，井；井養而不窮也。改邑不改井，乃以剛中也。汔至亦未繘井，未有功也。羸其瓶，是以凶也。
hexagrams.daxiang: 木上有水，井；君子以勞民勸相。

yao.xiang: 井泥不食，下也。舊井无禽，時舍也。

yao.text: 井渫不食，為我心惻，可用汲，王明，並受其福。
yao.xiang: 井渫不食，行惻也。求王明，受福也。

xugua.zh: 困乎上者，必反下，故受之以井。
xugua.en: One exhausted above must turn back down; therefore Jing follows.

hexagrams.logicZh: 在上面受困、走投無路，就要回到下面、回歸根本。井在地下，向下深挖才有水源。困與井互為綜卦： 困是澤中無水，井是取之不盡的水源。卦辭「改邑不改井」——城邑可以遷移，井卻一直在那裡供養眾人， 象徵恆常的根本與無私的奉獻。
hexagrams.logicEn: Stuck at the top with nowhere to go, one must turn back down to the foundations. A well lies below ground; only by digging down does one reach water. Kun 困 and Jing 井 are an inverted pair: a lake with no water, then an inexhaustible source. "The town may be moved, but not the well": settlements come and go while the well stays and nourishes all — an image of enduring foundations and selfless giving.

hexagrams.name: 革
hexagrams.gistZh: 水火相息，去故更新；變革須順天應人。
hexagrams.gistEn: Fire and water quench each other — renewal that must fit the times and win trust.
hexagrams.judgment: 已日乃孚，元亨。利貞。悔亡。
hexagrams.tuan: 革，水火相息，二女同居，其志不相得，曰革。已日乃孚；革而信也。文明以說，大亨以正，革而當，其悔乃亡。天地革而四時成，湯武革命，順乎天而應乎人，革之時義大矣哉！
hexagrams.daxiang: 澤中有火，革；君子以治歷明時。

yao.xiang: 鞏用黃牛，不可以有為也。

yao.text: 征凶，貞厲，革言三就，有孚。
君子豹變，小人革面，征凶，居貞吉。
yao.xiang: 君子豹變，其文蔚也。小人革面，順以從君也。

xugua.zh: 井道不可不革，故受之以革。
xugua.en: The way of the well cannot but be renewed; therefore Ge follows.

hexagrams.logicZh: 井用久了，泥沙淤積，必須定期淘洗更新，否則水會污濁。由此推廣：任何制度用久了都需要變革。革卦離（火）在下、 兌（澤）在上，水火相息，必然產生變化。「革」本義是去毛的獸皮，引申為變革。彖傳說「湯武革命，順乎天而應乎人」： 變革必須順應天時、得到人心，時機成熟（「已日乃孚」）。
hexagrams.logicEn: A well used for long silts up and must be cleaned out, or the water turns foul. More broadly, any institution in long use needs reform. Ge 革 has Fire beneath Lake: water and fire extinguish each other, so change is inevitable. 革 originally means a hide stripped of hair, hence transformation. "Tang and Wu changed the mandate, in accord with heaven and in response to the people": revolution must fit the times and win people's trust, and wait until the moment is ripe.

hexagrams.name: 鼎
hexagrams.gistZh: 烹飪轉化，取新立制；正位凝命。
hexagrams.gistEn: Cooking transforms — the new order is founded and secured.
hexagrams.tuan: 鼎，象也。以木巽火，亨飪也。聖人亨以享上帝，而大亨以養聖賢。巽而耳目聰明，柔進而上行，得中而應乎剛，是以元亨。
hexagrams.daxiang: 木上有火，鼎；君子以正位凝命。

yao.text: 鼎顛趾，利出否，得妾以其子，无咎。
yao.xiang: 鼎顛趾，未悖也。利出否，以從貴也。

yao.text: 鼎有實，我仇有疾，不我能即，吉。
yao.xiang: 鼎有實，慎所之也。我仇有疾，終无尤也。

yao.text: 鼎耳革，其行塞，雉膏不食，方雨虧悔，終吉。
鼎折足，覆公餗，其形渥，凶。

xugua.zh: 革物者莫若鼎，故受之以鼎。
xugua.en: Nothing transforms things like the cauldron; therefore Ding follows.

hexagrams.logicZh: 能夠徹底改變事物的，莫過於鼎——生食放進鼎中烹煮，就變成熟食。革與鼎互為綜卦：革是去故，鼎是取新。 鼎又是國家的重器、權力的象徵，變革之後要建立新的秩序，象傳說「君子以正位凝命」。卦形本身就像一隻鼎： 初爻為足，二三四為腹，五為耳，上為鉉。
hexagrams.logicEn: Nothing changes things more thoroughly than the cauldron: raw food goes in and comes out cooked. Ge 革 and Ding 鼎 are an inverted pair: Ge removes the old, Ding establishes the new. The ding was also the state's sacred vessel and the symbol of legitimate power; after revolution a new order must be founded — "the superior person rectifies positions and secures the mandate." The hexagram even looks like a ding: legs at the bottom, belly in lines two to four, ears at the fifth, and the carrying bar on top.

hexagrams.name: 震
hexagrams.gistZh: 雷聲震動，恐懼修省；戒慎之後，談笑自若。
hexagrams.gistEn: Shock upon shock — fear brings self-examination, and then calm laughter.
hexagrams.judgment: 亨。震來虩虩，笑言啞啞。震驚百里，不喪匕鬯。
hexagrams.tuan: 震，亨。震來虩虩，恐致福也。笑言啞啞，後有則也。震驚百里，驚遠而懼邇也。出可以守宗廟社稷，以為祭主也。
hexagrams.daxiang: 洊雷，震；君子以恐懼修省。

yao.text: 震來虩虩，後笑言啞啞，吉。
yao.xiang: 震來虩虩，恐致福也。笑言啞啞，後有則也。

yao.text: 震來厲，億喪貝，躋于九陵，勿逐，七日得。

yao.xiang: 震往來厲，危行也。其事在中，大无喪也。

yao.text: 震索索，視矍矍，征凶。震不于其躬，于其鄰，无咎。婚媾有言。
yao.xiang: 震索索，中未得也。雖凶无咎，畏鄰戒也。

xugua.zh: 主器者莫若長子，故受之以震；震者動也。
xugua.en: No one is more fit to preside over the vessels than the eldest son; therefore Zhen follows. Zhen means movement.

hexagrams.logicZh: 鼎是祭祀的重器，主持祭祀、繼承重器的是長子。震在八卦中代表長男，所以鼎之後是震。震為雷，上下皆雷， 雷聲震動，令人驚懼。卦辭「震來虩虩，笑言啞啞」：雷聲來時令人恐懼戒慎，因戒慎而無過失，事後便能談笑自若—— 象傳說「君子以恐懼修省」。
hexagrams.logicEn: The ding was the great ritual vessel, and the one who presided over the rites and inherited the vessels was the eldest son. Among the eight trigrams Zhen 震 is the eldest son, so Zhen follows Ding 鼎. Zhen is thunder, doubled: shock upon shock. "Thunder comes — fear and trembling; then laughing words": shock makes us cautious, caution keeps us from error, and afterward we can laugh. "The superior person, in fear and trembling, cultivates and examines themselves."

hexagrams.name: 艮
hexagrams.gistZh: 兩山重疊，時止則止，時行則行。
hexagrams.gistEn: Mountain upon mountain — stop when it is time to stop, move when it is time to move.
hexagrams.judgment: 艮其背，不獲其身，行其庭，不見其人，无咎。
hexagrams.tuan: 艮，止也。時止則止，時行則行，動靜不失其時，其道光明。艮其止，止其所也。上下敵應，不相與也。是以不獲其身，行其庭不見其人，无咎也。
hexagrams.daxiang: 兼山，艮；君子以思不出其位。

yao.text: 艮其腓，不拯其隨，其心不快。

xugua.zh: 物不可以終動，止之，故受之以艮；艮者止也。
xugua.en: Things cannot move forever; they are brought to rest; therefore Gen follows. Gen means stopping.

hexagrams.logicZh: 運動不能永無休止，動極則靜。震與艮互為綜卦：震是一陽在下奮動，艮是一陽在上而止。艮為山，兩山重疊，安然不動。 艮的「止」是彖傳所說「時止則止，時行則行」，知道該停在哪裡；象傳說「君子以思不出其位」。宋明儒者特別重視此卦的修養意義。
hexagrams.logicEn: Motion cannot go on forever; at its extreme it turns to stillness. Zhen 震 and Gen 艮 are an inverted pair: a yang line surging up from below, then a yang line at rest on top. Gen is mountain, doubled: two peaks, utterly still. Its stillness means "stopping when it is time to stop, moving when it is time to move" — knowing where to rest. "The superior person does not let their thoughts go beyond their position." Song and Ming Confucians prized it for self-cultivation.

hexagrams.name: 漸
hexagrams.gistZh: 山上之木，鴻雁漸飛——循序漸進。
hexagrams.gistEn: Trees on the mountain, geese rising stage by stage — step-by-step progress.
hexagrams.tuan: 漸之進也，女歸吉也。進得位，往有功也。進以正，可以正邦也。其位剛，得中也。止而巽，動不窮也。
hexagrams.daxiang: 山上有木，漸；君子以居賢德，善俗。

yao.text: 鴻漸于干，小子厲，有言，无咎。
鴻漸于陸，夫征不復，婦孕不育，凶；利禦寇。
yao.xiang: 夫征不復，離羣醜也。婦孕不育，失其道也。利用禦寇，順相保也。

yao.text: 鴻漸于木，或得其桷，无咎。
鴻漸于陵，婦三歲不孕，終莫之勝，吉。
鴻漸于陸，其羽可用為儀，吉。
yao.xiang: 其羽可用為儀，吉；不可亂也。

xugua.zh: 物不可以終止，故受之以漸；漸者進也。
xugua.en: Things cannot be at rest forever; therefore Jian follows. Jian means advancing.

hexagrams.logicZh: 靜止之後又要前進，但這次是循序漸進。漸卦巽（木）在艮（山）上，山上的樹木慢慢長高。卦辭「女歸吉」， 以女子出嫁要依禮按步驟進行來比喻漸進之道；六爻都以鴻雁為象，從水邊、磐石、陸地、樹木、山陵一步步升高。 這和晉卦的「進」不同，漸強調次序與耐心。
hexagrams.logicEn: After stillness comes advance again, but now step by step. Jian 漸 is Wood on the Mountain, trees growing slowly on a slope. "The maiden goes to marry; good fortune": a proper marriage proceeds through ordered stages. All six lines use the wild goose, moving up from the shore to a rock, dry land, a tree, a hill and the heights. Unlike the advance of Jin 晉 (35), Jian stresses sequence and patience.

hexagrams.name: 歸妹
hexagrams.gistZh: 少女急於歸嫁，以悅而動；有歸宿也須循正道。
hexagrams.gistEn: A young girl eager to marry — even a destination must be reached the right way.
hexagrams.tuan: 歸妹，天地之大義也。天地不交，而萬物不興，歸妹人之終始也。說以動，所歸妹也。征凶，位不當也。无攸利，柔乘剛也。
hexagrams.daxiang: 澤上有雷，歸妹；君子以永終知敝。

yao.xiang: 歸妹以娣，以恆也。跛能履吉，相承也。

yao.text: 帝乙歸妹，其君之袂，不如其娣之袂良，月幾望，吉。
yao.xiang: 帝乙歸妹，不如其娣之袂良也。其位在中，以貴行也。

yao.text: 女承筐无實，士刲羊无血，无攸利。

xugua.zh: 進必有所歸，故受之以歸妹。
xugua.en: Advance must have a destination; therefore Gui Mei follows.

hexagrams.logicZh: 前進總要有個歸宿。「歸」是女子出嫁，「妹」是少女。漸與歸妹互為綜卦，也互為錯卦：漸是依禮漸進的婚姻； 歸妹則是少女（兌）主動追隨長男（震），以悅而動，不依常禮，所以卦辭說「征凶，无攸利」。它提醒人： 急於找到歸宿而不循正道，往往有始無終——象傳說「君子以永終知敝」。
hexagrams.logicEn: Every advance needs a place to arrive. 歸 is a woman going to marry; 妹 is a young girl. Jian 漸 and Gui Mei 歸妹 are both inverted and opposite versions of each other: Jian is marriage proceeding by proper stages, while in Gui Mei the young girl (Lake) eagerly follows the eldest son (Thunder), moved by delight rather than ritual — so "going forth brings misfortune." Grabbing at a destination without the right path rarely ends well: "the superior person understands the lasting end and knows what wears things out."

hexagrams.name: 豐
hexagrams.gistZh: 雷電交作，如日中天；盛極將昃。
hexagrams.gistEn: Thunder and lightning together, the sun at noon — the peak before decline.
hexagrams.tuan: 豐，大也。明以動，故豐。王假之，尚大也。勿憂宜日中，宜照天下也。日中則昃，月盈則食，天地盈虛，與時消息，而況于人乎？況于鬼神乎？
hexagrams.daxiang: 雷電皆至，豐；君子以折獄致刑。

yao.text: 遇其配主，雖旬无咎，往有尚。
豐其蔀，日中見斗，往得疑疾，有孚發若，吉。
豐其沛，日中見沬，折其右肱，无咎。
yao.xiang: 豐其沛，不可大事也。折其右肱，終不可用也。

yao.text: 豐其蔀，日中見斗，遇其夷主，吉。
yao.xiang: 豐其蔀，位不當也。日中見斗，幽不明也。遇其夷主，吉；行也。

yao.text: 豐其屋，蔀其家，窺其戶，闃其无人，三歲不覿，凶。
yao.xiang: 豐其屋，天際翔也。窺其戶，闃其无人，自藏也。

xugua.zh: 得其所歸者必大，故受之以豐；豐者大也。
xugua.en: One who finds where they belong is sure to become great; therefore Feng follows. Feng means great.

hexagrams.logicZh: 找到合適的歸宿，便能興旺壯大。豐卦震（雷）在上、離（電）在下，雷電交作，聲光盛大。卦辭「王假之，勿憂，宜日中」—— 到了鼎盛之時，如同正午的太陽。但彖傳立即提醒「日中則昃，月盈則食」：豐盛的頂點，也就是衰落的開始。
hexagrams.logicEn: Finding where one belongs leads to prosperity and greatness. Feng 豐 is Thunder above Lightning (Fire): sound and light at full strength. "The king attains it; do not worry; be like the sun at midday" — a time of peak abundance. But the Tuan adds at once: "when the sun reaches noon it starts to set; when the moon is full it starts to wane." The height of abundance is the start of decline.

hexagrams.name: 旅
hexagrams.gistZh: 山上之火，過而不留；客居他鄉，柔順守正。
hexagrams.gistEn: Fire on the mountain moves on — far from home, be gentle and upright.
hexagrams.tuan: 旅，小亨，柔得中乎外，而順乎剛，止而麗乎明，是以小亨，旅貞吉也。旅之時義大矣哉！
hexagrams.daxiang: 山上有火，旅；君子以明慎用刑，而不留獄。

yao.text: 旅即次，懷其資，得童僕貞。
旅焚其次，喪其童僕，貞厲。
yao.xiang: 旅焚其次，亦以傷矣。以旅與下，其義喪也。

yao.text: 旅于處，得其資斧，我心不快。
yao.xiang: 旅于處，未得位也。得其資斧，心未快也。

yao.text: 鳥焚其巢，旅人先笑後號咷。喪牛于易，凶。
yao.xiang: 以旅在上，其義焚也。喪牛于易，終莫之聞也。

xugua.zh: 窮大者必失其居，故受之以旅。
xugua.en: One who exhausts greatness is sure to lose their home; therefore Lü follows.

hexagrams.logicZh: 盛大到了極點而不知收斂，必然失去安身之所，流落他鄉。豐與旅互為綜卦。旅卦離（火）在艮（山）上， 山上的火燒過即走、不能久留，如同旅人。羈旅在外，處處受限，卦辭說「小亨，旅貞吉」：客居他鄉，要謙和柔順、守正自持。
hexagrams.logicEn: Push greatness to the limit without restraint and you lose your place and end up wandering. Feng 豐 and Lü 旅 are an inverted pair. Lü is Fire on the Mountain: a brush fire that burns through and moves on, never staying — like a traveler. Away from home everything is constrained: "small success; for the traveler, steadfastness brings good fortune." A guest abroad should be gentle, humble and upright.

hexagrams.name: 巽
hexagrams.gistZh: 隨風而入，無孔不入——以柔順深入人心。
hexagrams.gistEn: Wind gets in everywhere — reaching hearts through gentleness.
hexagrams.judgment: 小亨。利有攸往。利見大人。
hexagrams.tuan: 重巽以申命，剛巽乎中正而志行。柔皆順乎剛，是以小亨，利有攸往，利見大人。
hexagrams.daxiang: 隨風，巽；君子以申命行事。

yao.xiang: 進退，志疑也。利武人之貞，志治也。

yao.text: 巽在牀下，用史巫紛若，吉无咎。
貞吉悔亡，无不利。无初有終，先庚三日，後庚三日，吉。
巽在牀下，喪其資斧，貞凶。
yao.xiang: 巽在牀下，上窮也。喪其資斧，正乎凶也。

xugua.zh: 旅而無所容，故受之以巽；巽者入也。
xugua.en: The traveler has nowhere to be taken in; therefore Xun follows. Xun means entering.

hexagrams.logicZh: 旅人無處容身，只有謙遜柔順，才能被接納、進入。巽為風，風無孔不入；上下皆巽，柔順至極。巽卦的「入」， 是以柔順謙遜的態度深入人心；象傳說「君子以申命行事」——如風之吹拂，反覆申明，使政令深入人心。
hexagrams.logicEn: A traveler with nowhere to stay can be taken in only by being humble and yielding. Xun 巽 is wind, which gets in everywhere; doubled, it is gentleness itself. Its "entering" means reaching people's hearts through a gentle, modest manner. "The superior person repeats commands and carries out affairs" — like wind blowing again and again until the message sinks in.

hexagrams.name: 兌
hexagrams.gistZh: 兩澤相連，互相滋潤；朋友講習之樂。
hexagrams.gistEn: Two lakes joined, refreshing each other — the joy of learning with friends.
hexagrams.tuan: 兌，說也。剛中而柔外，說以利貞，是以順乎天，而應乎人。說以先民，民忘其勞；說以犯難，民忘其死；說之大，民勸矣哉！
hexagrams.daxiang: 麗澤，兌；君子以朋友講習。

xugua.zh: 入而后說之，故受之以兌；兌者說也。
xugua.en: Having entered, there is then delight; therefore Dui follows. Dui means delight.

hexagrams.logicZh: 被接納、融入之後，人與人之間便有了喜悅（「說」即「悅」）。巽與兌互為綜卦。兌為澤，兩澤相連，互相滋潤， 象傳說「君子以朋友講習」——朋友之間互相切磋，是最大的快樂。彖傳強調喜悅要「剛中而柔外」：以誠信為內核，而不是諂媚取悅。
hexagrams.logicEn: Once accepted and at home, people find joy together (說 here is 悅, delight). Xun 巽 and Dui 兌 are an inverted pair. Dui is lake, doubled: two lakes joined, refreshing each other. "The superior person joins with friends for discussion and practice" — learning with friends is the greatest joy. The Tuan says true delight is "firm within, gentle without," grounded in sincerity rather than flattery.

hexagrams.name: 渙
hexagrams.gistZh: 風行水上，波紋四散；人心離散時，須重新凝聚。
hexagrams.gistEn: Wind over water, ripples spreading — when people scatter, gather them again.
hexagrams.judgment: 亨，王假有廟，利涉大川，利貞。
hexagrams.tuan: 渙，亨。剛來而不窮，柔得位乎外而上同。王假有廟，王乃在中也。利涉大川，乘木有功也。
hexagrams.daxiang: 風行水上，渙；先王以享于帝立廟。

yao.text: 渙其群，元吉。渙有丘，匪夷所思。
渙汗其大號，渙王居，无咎。

xugua.zh: 說而后散之，故受之以渙；渙者離也。
xugua.en: After delight comes dispersal; therefore Huan follows. Huan means scattering.

hexagrams.logicZh: 喜悅使人心舒展、鬆散開來，到頭來便會渙散離析。渙卦巽（風）行坎（水）上，風吹水面，波紋四散。 但渙散也有積極的一面：化解鬱結、消散險難。卦辭「王假有廟，利涉大川」——人心離散之時，要以宗廟祭祀重新凝聚， 共同渡過大川。
hexagrams.logicEn: Joy relaxes and loosens people, and in the end loosening becomes dispersal. Huan 渙 is Wind moving over Water: ripples spreading in every direction. But dispersal has a positive side too, dissolving blockages and dangers. "The king approaches his temple; beneficial to cross the great river": when people drift apart, shared ritual can gather them again to cross the great river together.

hexagrams.name: 節
hexagrams.gistZh: 澤容水有限——節制有度，苦節不可貞。
hexagrams.gistEn: A lake holds only so much — measure and moderation, but not harsh restraint.
hexagrams.tuan: 節，亨，剛柔分，而剛得中。苦節不可貞，其道窮也。說以行險，當位以節，中正以通。天地節而四時成，節以制度，不傷財，不害民。
hexagrams.daxiang: 澤上有水，節；君子以制數度，議德行。

xugua.zh: 物不可以終離，故受之以節。
xugua.en: Things cannot stay scattered forever; therefore Jie follows.

hexagrams.logicZh: 渙散不能沒有止境，必須加以節制。渙與節互為綜卦。節卦坎（水）在兌（澤）上，澤容水有限，滿則溢出，所以要有節度。 「節」本是竹節，一段一段有分寸。卦辭也提醒「苦節不可貞」——節制過度，令人痛苦，也不能長久，貴在適中。
hexagrams.logicEn: Dispersal cannot go on without limit; it needs regulating. Huan 渙 and Jie 節 are an inverted pair. Jie is Water above Lake: a lake holds only so much and overflows when full, so there must be measure. 節 originally means the joints of bamboo that divide it into segments. But "bitter limitation should not be persisted in": excessive restraint is painful and cannot last. The key is moderation.

hexagrams.name: 中孚
hexagrams.gistZh: 中虛而中實——內心誠信，感及豚魚。
hexagrams.gistEn: Empty at the core, firm at the center — sincerity that moves even pigs and fish.
hexagrams.tuan: 中孚，柔在內而剛得中。說而巽，孚，乃化邦也。豚魚吉，信及豚魚也。利涉大川，乘木舟虛也。中孚以利貞，乃應乎天也。
hexagrams.daxiang: 澤上有風，中孚；君子以議獄緩死。

yao.text: 鳴鶴在陰，其子和之，我有好爵，吾與爾靡之。
得敵，或鼓或罷，或泣或歌。

xugua.zh: 節而信之，故受之以中孚。
xugua.en: With limits, one is trusted; therefore Zhong Fu follows.

hexagrams.logicZh: 有了節度，人們便能相互信任。「中孚」是內心誠信。卦形兩陰在中、四陽在外，中虛象徵心中無私；九二、九五兩陽 又各居上下卦之中，象徵中心誠實。卦辭「豚魚吉」：誠信感化的力量，甚至能及於豬和魚。中孚與小過是一對錯卦。
hexagrams.logicEn: With measure and limits, people can trust one another. Zhong Fu 中孚 means inner sincerity. Two yin lines sit at the center inside four yang lines — emptiness at the core, a heart without selfishness — while yang lines hold the center of each trigram: firm sincerity within. "Pigs and fish: good fortune" — the power of sincerity reaches even pigs and fish. Zhong Fu 中孚 and Xiao Guo 小過 are a complementary pair (every line inverted).

hexagrams.name: 小過
hexagrams.gistZh: 小事可稍過，大事不可；飛鳥宜下不宜上。
hexagrams.gistEn: Small things may go a little too far, great ones not — the bird should fly low.
hexagrams.judgment: 亨。利貞。可小事，不可大事。飛鳥遺之音，不宜上宜下，大吉。
hexagrams.tuan: 小過，小者過而亨也。過以利貞，與時行也。柔得中，是以小事吉也。剛失位而不中，是以不可大事也。有飛鳥之象焉，有飛鳥遺之音，不宜上宜下，大吉；上逆而下順也。
hexagrams.daxiang: 山上有雷，小過；君子以行過乎恭，喪過乎哀，用過乎儉。

yao.text: 過其祖，遇其妣；不及其君，遇其臣；无咎。
无咎，弗過遇之。往厲必戒，勿用永貞。
yao.xiang: 弗過遇之，位不當也。往厲必戒，終不可長也。

yao.text: 密雲不雨，自我西郊，公弋取彼在穴。
弗遇過之，飛鳥離之，凶，是謂災眚。

xugua.zh: 有其信者，必行之，故受之以小過。
xugua.en: Those who have trust are sure to act on it; therefore Xiao Guo follows.

hexagrams.logicZh: 有了誠信，必定付諸行動；而行動難免有所過度。小過是「小的過度」——四陰在外、二陽在內，陰柔稍過於陽剛。 卦辭「可小事，不可大事。飛鳥遺之音，不宜上，宜下」：小事上稍稍過分無妨，象傳說「行過乎恭，喪過乎哀，用過乎儉」， 但不宜好高騖遠。
hexagrams.logicEn: Those who have faith inevitably act on it, and action easily goes a little too far. Xiao Guo 小過 is "small excess": four yin lines outside and two yang within, the yielding slightly outweighing the firm. "Small matters may be done, not great ones. The flying bird leaves its call: it should not go up but down." Erring slightly in small things is fine — "too courteous in conduct, too sorrowful in mourning, too frugal in spending" — but do not overreach.

hexagrams.name: 既濟
hexagrams.gistZh: 六爻皆當位，事已成；初吉終亂，守成更難。
hexagrams.gistEn: Every line in place, the task complete — yet order at the start, disorder at the end.
hexagrams.tuan: 既濟，亨，小者亨也。利貞，剛柔正而位當也。初吉，柔得中也。終止則亂，其道窮也。
hexagrams.daxiang: 水在火上，既濟；君子以思患而豫防之。

yao.text: 高宗伐鬼方，三年克之，小人勿用。
東鄰殺牛，不如西鄰之禴祭，實受其福。
yao.xiang: 東鄰殺牛，不如西鄰之時也；實受其福，吉大來也。

xugua.zh: 有過物者，必濟，故受之既濟。
xugua.en: Those who go beyond others are sure to succeed; therefore Ji Ji follows.

hexagrams.logicZh: 能夠超越常人、有所作為的人，必然能成就事業。「濟」是渡河，引申為成功。既濟卦六爻陰陽各得其位（陽爻在奇數位、 陰爻在偶數位），是六十四卦中唯一完全「當位」的卦，代表一切都已完成。但卦辭說「初吉終亂」：完成之時， 就是混亂的開始，守成比創業更難。（序卦原文此句作「故受之既濟」，比其他句子少一個「以」字。）
hexagrams.logicEn: Those who can go beyond the ordinary are sure to accomplish things. 濟 means crossing a river, hence success. In Ji Ji 既濟 every line is in its proper place (yang in odd positions, yin in even) — the only hexagram so perfectly ordered, everything completed. Yet "good fortune at the beginning, disorder at the end": the moment of completion is where disorder starts, and keeping success is harder than winning it. (The Xugua text reads 故受之既濟, lacking the 以 found in every other sentence.)

hexagrams.name: 未濟
hexagrams.gistZh: 六爻皆不當位，一切重新開始——終即是始。
hexagrams.gistEn: Every line out of place, everything begins anew — the end is a beginning.
hexagrams.judgment: 亨。小狐汔濟，濡其尾，无攸利。
hexagrams.tuan: 未濟，亨；柔得中也。小狐汔濟，未出中也。濡其尾，无攸利；不續終也。雖不當位，剛柔應也。
hexagrams.daxiang: 火在水上，未濟；君子以慎辨物居方。

yao.text: 貞吉，悔亡，震用伐鬼方，三年有賞于大國。
貞吉，无悔，君子之光，有孚，吉。
有孚于飲酒，无咎，濡其首，有孚失是。

xugua.zh: 物不可窮也，故受之以未濟；終焉。
xugua.en: Things can never be exhausted; therefore Wei Ji follows — and there the sequence ends.

hexagrams.logicZh: 事物不可能有窮盡的時候，所以六十四卦不以「既濟」（已完成）作結，而以「未濟」（尚未完成）收尾。 既濟與未濟互為綜卦，也互為錯卦：未濟六爻皆不當位，一切又重新開始。這是整個卦序最深刻的一筆—— 宇宙與人生永遠在途中，結束即是新的開端。
hexagrams.logicEn: Things can never be exhausted, so the sixty-four hexagrams end not with Ji Ji 既濟, "already complete," but with Wei Ji 未濟, "not yet complete." The two are both inverted and opposite versions of each other: in Wei Ji every line is out of place, and everything begins anew. This is the sequence's most profound stroke — the cosmos and human life are always on the way, and every ending is a new beginning.

essays.bodyZh: 《序卦傳》是「十翼」之一，也就是解釋《易經》的十篇古傳之一，傳統上歸於孔子，學者一般認為成書於戰國至漢初。 它做的事很簡單：為今本六十四卦的排列順序，一卦一卦說明「為什麼這一卦接在那一卦後面」。它常用兩種手法： 一是以字釋卦（如「蒙者蒙也」「師者眾也」），二是用因果鏈條把前後卦串起來（如「物生必蒙」「飲食必有訟」）。 魏晉的韓康伯注說，序卦所講的並不是《易》最深的義理，而是「因卦之次，託以明義」——借著卦的次序來說明道理。 所以讀序卦傳，不必把每一環都當作嚴格的邏輯推論；把它看作一部關於萬物生成、人事興衰的「連續故事」，最能體會它的用意。
essays.bodyEn: The Xugua 序卦傳, "Ordering the Hexagrams," is one of the Ten Wings, the ancient commentaries attached to the Book of Changes. Tradition credits Confucius; scholars generally date it to the Warring States or early Han. Its task is simple: for the received order of the sixty-four hexagrams, it explains, one by one, why each hexagram follows the one before. It uses two techniques: glossing a name by a word ("Meng means covered," "Shi means the multitude") and linking neighbors by cause and effect ("what is born is immature," "where there is food there will be disputes"). The commentator Han Kangbo (4th century) remarked that the Xugua does not contain the deepest meaning of the Changes; rather, it "takes the order of the hexagrams as an occasion to explain principles." So don't read every link as strict logic. Read it as one continuous story about how things come to be and how human affairs rise and fall.

essays.bodyZh: 六十四卦分為上經三十卦（乾至離）與下經三十四卦（咸至未濟）。數目看似不均，其實很平衡：若把上下顛倒後相同的卦 算作一個「卦形」，上經有六個自身對稱的卦（乾、坤、頤、大過、坎、離）加十二對綜卦，共十八形；下經有兩個對稱卦 （中孚、小過）加十六對綜卦，也是十八形。上經以乾坤（天地）開篇、以坎離（水火、日月）收尾，偏重天道與自然； 下經以咸恆（夫婦）開篇，偏重人倫與人事，最後以既濟、未濟收尾——這兩卦正是坎離的交錯組合，與上經的結尾遙相呼應。
essays.bodyEn: The hexagrams are split into the Upper Canon, 30 hexagrams (Qian 乾 to Li 離), and the Lower Canon, 34 (Xian 咸 to Wei Ji 未濟). The numbers look uneven but balance perfectly: count each hexagram and its upside-down form as one "shape," and the Upper Canon has six self-symmetrical hexagrams (Qian, Kun, Yi 頤, Da Guo, Kan, Li) plus twelve inverted pairs — 18 shapes; the Lower has two symmetrical ones (Zhong Fu, Xiao Guo) plus sixteen pairs — also 18. The Upper Canon opens with Qian and Kun (heaven and earth) and closes with Kan and Li (water and fire, moon and sun): the way of nature. The Lower opens with Xian and Heng (husband and wife): the way of human life. It ends with Ji Ji and Wei Ji, which are themselves Kan and Li interlaced, echoing the end of the Upper Canon.

essays.titleEn: Paired two by two: inverted or else changed
essays.bodyZh: 唐代孔穎達在《周易正義》中指出：今本卦序「二二相耦，非覆即變」。六十四卦兩兩成對（1–2、3–4……63–64）， 每對之中，第二卦要麼是第一卦上下顛倒（「覆」，後世稱「綜卦」），要麼在顛倒後不變時，就把六爻陰陽全部反轉 （「變」，後世稱「錯卦」）。顛倒成對的有二十八對；只有四對因為卦形上下對稱，只能用陰陽全反配對：乾坤、頤大過、 坎離、中孚小過。這是學習卦序最有用的一把鑰匙：記住每對中的第一卦，第二卦往往就是把它倒過來看。 另外，泰否、隨蠱、漸歸妹、既濟未濟這四對既是綜卦也是錯卦。
essays.bodyEn: The Tang scholar Kong Yingda observed that the received order is "paired two by two: inverted or else changed." The sixty-four form 32 pairs (1–2, 3–4 … 63–64). In each pair, the second hexagram is either the first turned upside down (fu 覆, later called zong 綜, "inverted"), or, when turning it over changes nothing, the first with every line switched between yin and yang (bian 變, later cuo 錯, "complementary"). Twenty-eight pairs are inversions; only four pairs are symmetrical top to bottom and so must be paired by inverting every line: Qian–Kun, Yi–Da Guo, Kan–Li, Zhong Fu–Xiao Guo. This is the single most useful key for learning the order: know the first hexagram of each pair, and the second is usually that same figure seen upside down. Four pairs — Tai–Pi, Sui–Gu, Jian–Gui Mei and Ji Ji–Wei Ji — are both inversions and complements.

essays.titleEn: Three kinds of link: consequence, reversal, remedy
essays.bodyZh: 細讀序卦傳的六十三句，可以把卦與卦之間的銜接大致分成三類（這是為了方便學習所作的歸納，並非序卦傳原有的術語）： 「承」——前一卦自然導致後一卦，如「飲食必有訟」「進必有所傷」； 「反」——前一卦的狀態不能持久，物極而反，如「物不可以終通，故受之以否」「剝窮上反下，故受之以復」； 「補」——前一卦缺了什麼，後一卦正好補足，如「物穉不可不養也，故受之以需」「有大者不可以盈，故受之以謙」。 每一卦的頁面上都標有它屬於哪一種銜接。試著在測驗時先判斷銜接的種類，再回想後一卦，記憶會牢固得多。
essays.bodyEn: Reading the Xugua's 63 sentences closely, the links between neighboring hexagrams fall roughly into three kinds. (This grouping is a learning aid of ours, not the Xugua's own terminology.) Consequence 承 — the first naturally leads to the next: "where there is food there will be disputes," "advance is sure to meet injury." Reversal 反 — the first state cannot last, and at its extreme turns into its opposite: "things cannot flow freely forever, so Pi follows," "when stripping reaches the top it returns to the bottom, so Fu follows." Remedy 補 — the next supplies what the first lacks: "infant things must be nourished, so Xu follows," "one who has much must not overflow, so Qian 謙 follows." Every hexagram page shows which kind of link brings it in. When you quiz yourself, try naming the kind of link first and then recalling the next hexagram; the order sticks much better.

essays.titleZh: 物極必反：序卦傳的節奏
essays.titleEn: Reversal at the extreme: the rhythm of the Xugua
essays.bodyZh: 序卦傳中最常見的句式是「物不可以終……」：終通（否）、終否（同人）、終盡（復）、終過（坎）、終遯（大壯）、 終壯（晉）、終難（解）、終動（艮）、終止（漸）、終離（節）——共十次；另有「升而不已必困」「損而不已必益」 「益而不已必決」，以及最後的「物不可窮也」。這些句子構成了卦序的基本節奏：任何狀態發展到極點都會轉向它的反面， 而轉向之後又開始新的發展。泰→否、剝→復、損→益、既濟→未濟，是這種節奏最鮮明的例子。 序卦傳以「未濟」收尾，不讓故事停在「完成」，正是這種思想的總結：變化永無止境。
essays.bodyEn: The Xugua's most frequent formula is "things cannot … forever": cannot flow freely forever (Pi), stay blocked (Tong Ren), be used up (Fu), be in excess (Kan), withdraw (Da Zhuang), stay at full strength (Jin), be in difficulty (Xie), move (Gen), rest (Jian), stay scattered (Jie) — ten times in all. Add "rising without stopping leads to exhaustion," "decrease without end turns to increase," "increase without end leads to breakthrough," and the final "things can never be exhausted." These sentences set the basic rhythm of the sequence: every state, pushed to its limit, turns into its opposite, and from there a new development begins. Tai→Pi, Bo→Fu, Sun→Yi and Ji Ji→Wei Ji are the clearest cases. Ending with Wei Ji, "not yet complete," rather than letting the story stop at completion, sums up the whole idea: change never ends.

essays.bodyZh: 一、先背朱熹的〈卦名次序歌〉（見下方），把六十四個卦名的順序變成有節奏的韻文。 二、按「對」記憶：三十二對中，每對第二卦多半是第一卦倒過來；先在「瀏覽」頁打開「成對」視圖熟悉它們。 三、按「段落」記憶：下方把卦序分成十七個小段，每段講一個小故事（如「需訟師比」：吃飯→爭訟→戰爭→結盟）。 四、記住幾個錨點：1 乾、11 泰、12 否、23 剝、24 復、29 坎、30 離（上經終）、31 咸（下經始）、41 損、42 益、 49 革、50 鼎、63 既濟、64 未濟。 五、用「認卦」和「畫卦」測驗反覆練習；答錯的卦會更常出現。
essays.bodyEn: 1. Learn Zhu Xi's rhyme of hexagram names (below), which turns the sequence into rhythmic verse. 2. Learn in pairs: in most of the 32 pairs the second hexagram is the first upside down. Open the "pairs" view on the Browse page to get familiar with them. 3. Learn in stages: below, the sequence is divided into seventeen short stages, each telling a small story (e.g. Xu–Song–Shi–Bi: food → dispute → war → alliance). 4. Fix a few anchors: 1 Qian, 11 Tai, 12 Pi, 23 Bo, 24 Fu, 29 Kan, 30 Li (end of the Upper Canon), 31 Xian (start of the Lower), 41 Sun, 42 Yi, 49 Ge, 50 Ding, 63 Ji Ji, 64 Wei Ji. 5. Drill with the Identify and Draw quizzes; hexagrams you miss come back more often.

stages.summaryZh: 乾坤是一切的起點：創生與承載，天與地。
stages.summaryEn: Qian and Kun are the starting point of everything — creating and receiving, heaven and earth.

stages.summaryZh: 萬物初生（屯）→幼稚（蒙）→需要養育（需）→為飲食爭訟（訟）→爭端擴大為戰爭（師）→戰後結盟（比）。
stages.summaryEn: Birth (Zhun) → infancy (Meng) → nourishment (Xu) → disputes over food (Song) → war (Shi) → alliance (Bi).

stages.summaryZh: 團結而有積蓄（小畜）→有積蓄而知禮（履）→循禮而通泰（泰）→通極而閉塞（否）。
stages.summaryEn: Unity brings stores (Xiao Xu) → stores bring propriety (Lü) → propriety brings peace (Tai) → peace turns to stagnation (Pi).

stages.summaryZh: 打破閉塞要與人和同（同人）→眾人歸附而大有（大有）→大有不可自滿（謙）→謙而和樂（豫）。
stages.summaryEn: Breaking stagnation needs fellowship (Tong Ren) → people rally, bringing abundance (Da You) → abundance must not overflow (Qian 謙) → modesty brings joy (Yu).

stages.summaryZh: 和樂使人相隨（隨）→盲目相隨生弊（蠱）→整治而壯大（臨）→壯大而可觀（觀）。
stages.summaryEn: Joy draws followers (Sui) → careless following breeds decay (Gu) → repair makes one great (Lin) → greatness is worth beholding (Guan).

stages.summaryZh: 可觀而求合，要咬斷阻隔（噬嗑）→合須有文飾（賁）→文飾過度而剝落（剝）→剝盡而一陽來復（復）。
stages.summaryEn: Union requires biting through obstacles (Shi He) → union needs grace (Bi 賁) → too much ornament ends in decay (Bo) → decay complete, light returns (Fu).

stages.summaryZh: 復歸正道而無妄（无妄）→真誠方能大畜（大畜）→有積蓄才能養（頤）→養足而有非常之舉（大過）。
stages.summaryEn: Return brings sincerity (Wu Wang) → sincerity allows great stores (Da Xu) → stores allow nourishment (Yi 頤) → the nourished can do extraordinary things (Da Guo).

stages.summaryZh: 過度則陷入險（坎）→陷險須有所附麗（離）。上經以水火、日月作結。
stages.summaryEn: Excess falls into danger (Kan) → in danger one must cling to something (Li). The Upper Canon closes with water and fire, moon and sun.

stages.titleEn: The way of husband and wife
stages.summaryZh: 下經從人倫開始：男女相感（咸）→夫婦之道須長久（恆）。
stages.summaryEn: The Lower Canon begins with human bonds — attraction (Xian) → marriage must endure (Heng).

stages.summaryZh: 不可久居其位而退（遯）→退極復壯（大壯）→壯而前進（晉）→進而受傷（明夷）。
stages.summaryEn: One cannot stay put forever, so one retreats (Dun) → retreat turns to strength (Da Zhuang) → strength advances (Jin) → advance gets hurt (Ming Yi).

stages.summaryZh: 受傷回家（家人）→家道窮而乖離（睽）→乖離生患難（蹇）→患難終將解除（解）。
stages.summaryEn: The wounded come home (Jia Ren) → a failing household drifts apart (Kui) → estrangement brings hardship (Jian 蹇) → hardship is released (Xie).

stages.summaryZh: 鬆懈而有損（損）→損極轉益（益）→益極而決（夬）→決後又遇（姤）。
stages.summaryEn: Slackening brings loss (Sun) → loss turns to gain (Yi 益) → gain overflows into breakthrough (Guai) → after parting, a new meeting (Gou).

stages.summaryZh: 相遇而聚（萃）→聚而上升（升）→升而不已則困（困）→困於上者返歸於下（井）。
stages.summaryEn: Meeting leads to gathering (Cui) → gathering rises (Sheng) → endless rising exhausts (Kun 困) → the exhausted turn back down to the well (Jing).

stages.summaryZh: 井須淘洗而變革（革）→變革以鼎取新（鼎）→主鼎者為長子（震）→動極而止（艮）。
stages.summaryEn: The well must be renewed (Ge) → the cauldron establishes the new (Ding) → the eldest son presides over it (Zhen) → movement comes to rest (Gen).

stages.summaryZh: 止極復進（漸）→進必有所歸（歸妹）→得其所歸而豐大（豐）→盛極失居而為旅（旅）。
stages.summaryEn: Rest turns to gradual advance (Jian 漸) → advance seeks a home (Gui Mei) → belonging brings abundance (Feng) → overreaching ends in wandering (Lü 旅).

stages.summaryZh: 旅人以柔順而入（巽）→入而相悅（兌）→悅而渙散（渙）→散而須節（節）。
stages.summaryEn: The traveler enters by gentleness (Xun) → acceptance brings joy (Dui) → joy loosens into dispersal (Huan) → dispersal needs limits (Jie).

stages.summaryZh: 有節而有信（中孚）→有信必行而小過（小過）→過人者必濟（既濟）→物不可窮，終於未濟（未濟）。
stages.summaryEn: Measure builds trust (Zhong Fu) → trust acts and slightly overshoots (Xiao Guo) → those who go beyond succeed (Ji Ji) → nothing is ever finished (Wei Ji).

song.titleEn: Rhyme of the hexagram names in order (Zhu Xi)
